jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with OAuth
jobs.description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why.

At Endava, we harness technology to drive meaningful change. By combining AI-native engineering, deep industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we partner with leading organisations to solve complex business challenges and create digital products and platforms that make a lasting impact.

From strategy and design to engineering and operations, we help our customers accelerate innovation and transform their businesses. Join us and be part of a global team delivering work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you will join an experienced cross-functional engineering team responsible for designing, developing and evolving the Authentication and Authorization capability used across multiple products and engineering teams.

This is not a traditional application development role. Instead, you will help build a reusable identity platform that enables other engineering teams to adopt standardised authentication and authorisation services while improving security, developer experience and operational efficiency.

The capability provides shared identity and access management services that help applications authenticate users securely, authorise access to business resources and integrate with enterprise identity providers.

Built on Auth0, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) and modern Azure services, it includes reusable SDKs, reverse proxy services and developer tooling that make secure integration simpler across ICT’s technology landscape.

You will work closely with architects, product teams, platform engineers and business stakeholders helping deliver secure, scalable and high-quality technology solutions that create value for WTW and its customers. You will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of significant work packages and make sound technical decisions within the agreed platform direction.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

Help deliver secure, reusable authentication and authorization services used by multiple product teams.
Build high-quality .NET APIs, Angular administration tools and integration services that are maintainable and easy to operate.
Improve the reliability, scalability and security of shared identity services through well-tested engineering changes.
Support platform adoption by improving SDKs, documentation, developer tooling and integration patterns.
Contribute to automation, CI/CD and cloud platform improvements that make delivery faster and more predictable.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and consuming product teams to solve identity and access management challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture within the Quartz team.

Key Responsibilities

Identity Platform Development

Design, develop and maintain authentication and authorization services using modern .NET technologies.
Develop reusable platform services supporting secure authentication and authorization across multiple business applications.
Build scalable REST APIs and integration services used throughout the organisation.
Develop and maintain Angular-based administration portals supporting user, group and permission management.
Contribute to the evolution of Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) capabilities and centralized access management services.

Platform Services & Developer Experience

Develop reusable SDKs, libraries and APIs that simplify integration with the enterprise identity platform.
Build developer tooling that improves onboarding and adoption of shared authentication services.
Improve developer experience by simplifying authentication, authorization and platform integration.
Produce and maintain technical documentation supporting engineering teams consuming the platform.
Help minimise breaking changes by designing stable, reusable platform interfaces.
Take ownership of technical designs and implementation approaches for assigned capabilities, identifying dependencies, risks and trade-offs and following work through to a production-ready outcome.
Lead focused technical work packages and provide practical guidance to other engineers contributing to the same capability.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Develop cloud-native services running on Microsoft Azure.
Build and maintain reverse proxy capabilities using Azure API Management.
Support Infrastructure as Code implementation using OpenTofu/Terraform.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using Azure DevOps.
Support continuous improvements in platform scalability, security and operational resilience.

Engineering Excellence

Write unit, integration and automated tests ensuring platform quality and reliability.
Participate in peer reviews, architecture discussions and technical design sessions.
Promote engineering best practices including Clean Code, automated testing and secure software development.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, QA Engineers and Platform Engineers to deliver high-quality platform capabilities.
Support less experienced engineers through constructive reviews, knowledge sharing and technical mentoring.

Operations & Collaboration

Participate in third-line production support and on-call rotation.
Investigate production issues and contribute to platform reliability improvements.
Work closely with multiple product teams integrating with the platform.
Share knowledge and contribute to establishing long-term Endava ownership of the Authentication & Authorization capability.

Qualifications

Software Engineering

6+ years of commercial software development experience using C# and modern .NET.
Strong experience designing and developing REST APIs.
Experience building scalable enterprise applications or shared platform services.
Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming and modern software design principles.

Identity & Security

Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC) and JWT.
Good understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts.
Experience integrating applications with enterprise identity providers.
Understanding of secure API design and identity-based access control.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Experience developing cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or OpenTofu.
Understanding of Azure API Management or similar API Gateway technologies.

Front-End Development

Experience developing Angular applications using TypeScript.
Experience building administrative or developer-facing web applications.

Engineering Practices

Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration and API testing).
Experience working in Agile Scrum teams.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work effectively across multiple product teams.
Ability to influence technical outcomes across team boundaries, communicate delivery risks and contribute to decisions affecting shared platform consumers.

Preferred Skills and Experience

Auth0
Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA)
Google Zanzibar authorization model
Azure API Management (APIM)
SCIM integrations
Identity Federation Datadog
Playwright
Trivy
GitLeaks
Invicti
Experience building reusable developer platforms
Experience working with enterprise shared services

Additional Information

For this position, the gross base salary starts from PLN 19 267 PLN Gross per month (full-time employment contract), determined using objective and gender-neutral criteria including skillset, experience and role responsibilities.

Our benefits offering typically include private medical insurance, dental plan, and glasses reimbursement. The figure represents the initial remuneration we expect to offer for this role and does not limit the right to equal pay for women and men performing the same work or work of equal value. All remuneration and benefits decisions are based on non-discriminatory, gender-neutral criteria, and in accordance with the Polish Labour Code amendments implementing Directive on pay transparency, we do not request or consider candidates’ current or past remuneration during the recruitment process.”

jobs.title: CRM Developer – Dynamics 365 (M/F/NB)
jobs.description:
W Etteplan wierzymy, że technologia ma sens tylko wtedy, gdy realnie wspiera ludzi i procesy biznesowe. Wspieramy naszych klientów w tworzeniu i rozwoju systemów IT, które są stabilne, skalowalne i dopasowane do rzeczywistych potrzeb użytkowników. Pracujemy blisko biznesu, stawiając na jakość inżynierską, odpowiedzialność i partnerską współpracę.

O zespole i projekcie

Dołączysz do zespołu rozwijającego rozwiązanie oparte o Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM
, w którym system CRM stanowi kluczowy element większego ekosystemu integrującego różne procesy i systemy biznesowe. To projekt o mocno developerskim charakterze. Na co dzień będziesz rozwijać zarówno warstwę kliencką, jak i serwerową Dynamics 365 CRM, tworząc własne rozszerzenia, logikę biznesową oraz integracje z systemami zewnętrznymi. Zespół pracuje zgodnie z dobrymi praktykami inżynierskimi, dbając o jakość kodu, czytelność rozwiązań i ich dalszy rozwój.

Dlaczego warto?

To rola, w której:

rozwijasz Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM od strony developerskiej, a nie wyłącznie konfiguracyjnej,
pracujesz zarówno z TypeScript, jak i C#/.NET, rozwijając logikę po stronie klienta i serwera,
tworzysz pluginy, customizacje oraz integracje z systemami zewnętrznymi,
wykorzystujesz Azure Service Bus do komunikacji pomiędzy systemami,
masz realny wpływ na jakość rozwiązań i sposób ich implementacji.

Jeśli lubisz projekty, w których możesz rozwijać oprogramowanie, pracować z kodem i mieć wpływ na architekturę rozwiązania, ta rola będzie dobrym wyborem.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój client-side customizacji w Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM z wykorzystaniem TypeScript, w tym logiki formularzy, walidacji oraz obsługi elementów interfejsu,
rozwój pluginów C#/.NET odpowiedzialnych za logikę biznesową i customizacje encji,
implementację logiki obsługującej zdarzenia Create, Update i Delete,
rozwój integracji pomiędzy Dynamics 365 CRM a systemami zewnętrznymi z wykorzystaniem Azure Service Bus,
współpracę przy wdrożeniach aplikacji z wykorzystaniem wewnętrznych procesów CI/CD oraz narzędzi opartych o Power Apps,
dbanie o jakość kodu oraz stosowanie dobrych praktyk programistycznych.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz komercyjne doświadczenie w rozwoju Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM,
bardzo dobrze znasz C#/.NET oraz TypeScript / JavaScript,
masz doświadczenie w tworzeniu client-side customizacji formularzy Dynamics 365 CRM,
rozwijałeś/aś pluginy Dynamics 365 CRM oraz logikę biznesową po stronie serwera,
masz doświadczenie w integracji systemów z wykorzystaniem API lub kolejek komunikatów,
potrafisz pracować samodzielnie i brać odpowiedzialność za rozwijane rozwiązania,
swobodnie komunikujesz się w języku angielskim.

Docenimy również:

doświadczenie z Azure Service Bus,
znajomość usług Microsoft Azure,
doświadczenie z Power Platform (Power Apps lub Power Automate),
znajomość procesów CI/CD oraz pracy z Git.

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

rozwój poprzez pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku i różnorodnych projektach oraz dzielenie się wiedzą w grupach kompetencyjnych,
budżet szkoleniowy i budowanie indywidualnej ścieżki rozwoju podczas regularnych spotkań z menedżerem/menedżerką,
benefity, takie jak prywatna opieka medyczna Medicover, karta Multisport, grupowe ubezpieczenie na życie, dofinansowanie do posiłków,
elastyczność w zakresie godzin pracy i formy współpracy oraz możliwość korzystania z biur we Wrocławiu, Katowicach, Poznaniu i Gdańsku,
udział w inicjatywach technologicznych, wydarzeniach wewnętrznych i społecznościach tematycznych.

Jak przebiega proces rekrutacyjny?

Wyślij nam swoje CV – najlepiej w języku angielskim. W formularzu daj nam znać, jakie masz oczekiwania finansowe, preferowaną formę współpracy oraz od kiedy możesz rozpocząć pracę.
Sprawdzimy Twoją aplikację – przyjrzymy się Twojemu doświadczeniu i zobaczymy, jak pasuje do tej roli i projektu.
Rozmowa z HR (online) – luźna, partnerska rozmowa (ok. 40–60 minut), żeby lepiej się poznać, porozmawiać o Twojej drodze zawodowej, motywacji i oczekiwaniach.

Feedback – po zakończeniu procesu wrócimy do Ciebie z informacją zwrotną.

Możesz też zajrzeć na naszą stronę internetową lub Facebooka i zobaczyć, co ciekawego się u nas dzieje!

Company Description

Netcompany was founded in 2000 with the headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark. Today, we are an international company with more than 9000+ employees working from over 10 locations. We serve a wide array of customers in their digital transformation journeys in public and private sectors across Europe.

We are excited by the challenge of doing things differently. At Netcompany we rely on one another and we develop quickly. We are team players. We change societies by creating life-changing IT solutions for variety of customers – from small private companies to large projects in the public sector. Our culture builds on low bureaucracy with a strong focus on high agility and flexibility.

Job Description

Continue your development with us

In Netcompany we focus on your personal and professional development. We offer a structured career model where you can build upon the experiences you bring with you.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will be your sparring partner for your ongoing development as well as for your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in the leadership group provides you with concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and wishes.

Furthermore, you will participate in our training program, Netcompany Academy, where you will be offered courses and seminars tailored to your career stage. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your expertise. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company also creates a strong network and provides a solid foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Be a part of an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we prioritize community highly. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture that is built on collaboration and trust, and where there is always room for mutual sparring and support.

It is part of our culture and values that all employees, irrespective of backgrounds, identities, and experiences, are met with understanding and respect, as well as equal opportunities for development and well-being.

You will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate with colleagues from various cultures and nationalities, as we are an international company with offices in many countries.

We provide a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we offer a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network already early in your career.

As our new colleague in the Cloud Platform Services team, you will play a key role in agile projects for both large Danish and international customers. You have a unique opportunity to be part of a team responsible for multiple disciplines: Cloud Governance, Cloud Operations, Cloud Center of Excellence, and Cloud Consultancy.

We design and implement business-critical solutions on state-of-the-art infrastructure for customers, where you get hands-on experience with Azure. You will help build and operate our central architecture and solutions, impacting all our cloud solutions across all customers. You will ensure operations in the intersection of infrastructure, security, and the development of customer solutions. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to be lent out to other projects within the organization as a cloud consultant for both shorter and longer periods. All of which we convert to services that enhance and develop our central capability.

As a Cloud DevOps Engineer, Your Tasks Will Include

Monitoring, alerting, automation, and scaling of cloud solutions.
Creating coherence between development, operations, and security in accordance with DevOps and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tasks, e.g., Terraform, Bicep.
Operating with Version controlling system, e.g., Git.
Automation and standardization of Cloud Infrastructure processes (PowerShell/ Azure CLI).
Design and implementation of Cloud governance solutions.
Delivering internal methods/methodologies/principles into customer projects.
Leading or contributing to technical initiatives in the internal cloud infrastructure through experience from customer projects.

Have a bachelor's, master's, or engineering degree in ICT/IT, computer science, software/computer engineering, infrastructure, or other relevant vocational education experience.
Have experience with coding/scripting (.NET, Java, Web, PowerShell, Python) and/or DevOps (Terraform, CI/CD) from education or previous work.
Have experience with Azure or other Global Cloud Providers (e.g., AWS, GCP, OCI) from education or previous work.

Have good communication skills and Teamwork.
Have an excellent command of the English Language (written & verbal).

It would be beneficial (but not a must) if you:
Have work experience.
Have experience with infrastructure and operations.

Have certification in Azure or other relevant Microsoft areas.
Have experience with Kubernetes, containers, or Docker.

Career development programme for each employee and regular feedback.

jobs.title: Principal Full Stack Engineer, AI Platform & Agents
jobs.description:
Join us, at Wolters Kluwer, and be part of a dynamic global technology company that makes a difference every day.

We’re innovators with impact. We provide expert software and information solutions that the world’s leading professionals rely on, in the moments that matter most. You’ll make a real difference in the lives of millions of people. Together with our customers, we help to advance sustainability, health, justice, prosperity, and commerce around the world.

You can thrive at Wolters Kluwer, where diversity is core to our collective strength and high performance. Be your unique self, share your creative ideas, do your best work, and take time to grow in our caring and inclusive culture where you can belong.

About This Role

Our team is building a central GenAI Platform to empower hundreds of product teams across the organization with scalable capabilities for rapid development, validation, and deployment of AI agents. We also drive the development of the most impactful AI agents, ensuring faster delivery and greater impact across multiple domains. With over 20 agents already launched and many more in progress, our work accelerates innovation and improves outcomes in critical industries.

You'll join a 100-engineer team within a larger organization that combines the stability of an established company with the agility of a startup. In this high-autonomy, high-impact role, you'll take problems from concept to production, mentor less experienced engineers, and lead by example. You'll design and ship full-stack systems, shape platform capabilities to empower hundreds of product teams, and directly contribute to the development of the most impactful AI agents.

Flagship Agent: UpToDate Expert AI

In Health, we’re launching UpToDate Expert AI
—a medical research and clinical reasoning agent that transforms the world’s most widely used point‑of‑care knowledge resource into a real‑time medical assistant. Millions of physicians will rely on it to accelerate differential diagnosis, refine treatment decisions, and reduce cognitive load—while maintaining rigorous safety, privacy, and guideline fidelity. Improvements you ship (latency, reliability, hallucination reduction) will translate directly into faster, higher-quality patient care at global scale.

What You’ll Do

Design and implement full‑stack applications, AI agents, and platform components that enable rapid GenAI agent development, validation, and deployment.
Build developer tooling, CI/CD, and observability for safe, fast iteration (evals, canaries, rollout/rollback, cost and quality telemetry).
Apply secure SDLC and privacy‑by‑design practices (threat modeling, least privilege).
Collaborate with product, UX, and domain experts to deliver customer‑focused solutions with measurable outcomes.
Apply current LLM patterns (RAG, retrieval, routing, tool-use, evals) to deliver measurable customer value—faster, more reliable AI systems; reduced time-to-decision; improved trust/safety metrics; and lower cost per query.
Lead by example and be heavily hands-on: drive architecture, mentor engineers, and take ownership of larger projects.

Minimum Qualifications

8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Strong full‑stack development skills and cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Expert in at least one, and proficient across the others:
AI Agent development and evaluation
Backend development
Frontend development
Cloud services (AWS/Azure/GCP)
CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
Quality engineering / testing strategy
Secure SDLC and privacy by design

Proven track record delivering secure, reliable, cloud‑native systems to production.
Excellent problem‑solving, ownership, and cross‑functional communication.

Nice to have

Proven ability to deliver software products independently or as part of a small, fast-paced team.
Experience of taking AI agents from concept to production, including safety evaluations, iterative testing (e.g., A/B testing), and continuous improvement.
Experience with LangChain/LangGraph and MCP; vector/RAG systems; OpenSearch.
Worked on traditional ML tasks like training, deployment, and monitoring.
Understand how LLMs work, their failure modes, and techniques like fine-tuning and model adaptation.
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as SOC2, HIPAA, etc.

Stages

15‑minute intro screen
2× live coding in your preferred language
1× systems design
1× presentation of past work

Timeline:
Typically 2–4 weeks

Your first months

Month 1: Deep-dive into one platform component most aligned with your
expertise; ship small improvements while ramping up.
After onboarding: We’ll align on a high-impact area that fits your strengths
and ambitions.

To apply:

Please submit your resume
along with a brief cover letter
that includes a “Statement of Exceptional Work.”
In your cover letter, highlight one of your most impactful projects by addressing the following:

Your role and the problem space you were working in
The technical and product challenges you faced, and how you addressed them
The measurable impact of your work (e.g., metrics, outcomes, improvements)

This will help us better understand your approach to solving complex problems and the value you bring to the team.

Please do not include any proprietary or confidential information
in your submission

Be the Difference | If making a difference matters to you, then you matter to us.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Du arbetar nära både verksamhet och teknik och är delaktig i att designa, utveckla och vidareutveckla stabila och säkra lösningar. Rollen innebär att bidra i design-, arkitektur- och kravdiskussioner samt vara med och fatta tekniska vägval tillsammans med teamet.

Systemutveckling i C# / .NET
Backendutveckling och integrationer
Eventdriven arkitektur eller meddelandebaserade lösningar
ASP.NET / MVC och REST-baserade API:er
Databashantering med MS SQL, samt ORM-verktyg som EF Core eller Dapper
Versionshantering och CI/CD-flöden
Kommunikation på svenska, i tal och skrift

Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag.

Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

As part of a cross-functional product team, you’ll take meaningful ownership across the full software lifecycle:

Build & scale core services: Design, build, and ship robust backend services, APIs, and business-critical workflows using modern C# and .NET.
Shape system architecture: Drive decisions on scalability, resilience, and performance for high-throughput distributed systems.
Turn requirements into reality: Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate complex business needs into pragmatic technical solutions.
Elevate the team: Mentor colleagues, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge to help the engineering group grow.
Own production health: Champion automated testing, clean documentation, and reliable deployment practices so we ship with confidence.

Qualifications

Who you are:

You’re an experienced engineer who enjoys untangling complex problems and balances engineering excellence with pragmatic delivery:

Backend depth: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with deep expertise in C# and modern .NET.
Distributed systems: Practical experience designing clean REST APIs, message queues, event-driven workflows, and asynchronous communication patterns.
Data fluency: Strong background with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL), query optimization, and ORMs like EF Core or Dapper.
Cloud & DevOps: Experience deploying and managing containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes) in cloud environments, ideally Microsoft Azure.
Observability & troubleshooting: Skilled at diagnosing and resolving complex production issues using logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
Pragmatic tooling: Comfortable leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to move faster, while applying sharp judgment to ensure security and code quality.
Clear communication: Fluent in English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical partners.
Bonus points: Prior experience with FinTech, banking, payments, or ledger/accounting systems is a strong plus.

you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Sweden.

Would you like to help digitalize the forest industry and work with technology that makes a real difference to the environment and sustainability? We are now looking for a System Developer for a growing company here in Gothenburg that develops advanced systems to make forestry more efficient. Apply today, we review applications on an ongoing basis!

Location: Gothenburg

Our client is looking for a System Developer to support the continued growth of its operations in Poland. This expansion has created an increased need for technical support, system integrations, and development, particularly as the company continues to establish itself in the Polish market. As Poland is still a relatively new market for the company, fluency in Polish is essential to ensure clear communication and excellent customer support.

ABOUT THE POSITION:

In this role, you will have a central position in a close-knit development team, where you will help build solutions from the ground up and further develop existing systems.
You will work closely with the end customer, giving you a deep understanding of the business’s needs and how the systems are used in practice. This also means short decision-making paths and close dialogue with users, allowing you to quickly see the impact of what you develop.

The company focuses on digitalizing and streamlining the forest industry through data-driven solutions. An important part of the work involves systems connected to GIS (geographic information systems), where data is used, for example, to analyze environmental changes, water levels, and other factors that affect forestry. You will therefore work at the intersection of software development, data analysis, and real-world applications. From a technical perspective, the role primarily involves backend development in C#/.NET, often in cloud-based Microsoft Azure environments.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Develop and improve cloud-based applications in Microsoft Azure
Work with backend development in C#/.NET or similar programming languages and technologies
Collaborate closely with both internal developers and the customer
Help streamline processes within the forestry industry

WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO:

Has a bachelor’s or master’s degree in software development, computer engineering, or another field that the employer considers relevant
Has several years of professional experience in software development
Has professional experience with C#/.NET

It is not necessary, but considered an advantage if you have:

Experience with or an interest in GIS systems
Professional experience from the forest industry
Experience with Python and/or C/C++

Furthermore, we place great emphasis on personal suitability. We are looking for someone who is curious and proactive, who does not hesitate to ask questions when something is unclear, and who enjoys collaborating with others. You are a team player who actively contributes to a positive and inclusive team culture. In addition, our customer is located in very pleasant, bright premises where you have access to a shared gym.

ABOUT THE EMPLOYMENT:

This is a consulting assignment, which means that you will initially be employed by Friday. The ambition of both the customer and ourselves is for you to subsequently become permanently employed by the customer company.

OTHER INFORMATION:

Scope: Full-time
Start date: By agreement
Location: Gothenburg
Salary: Competitive monthly salary

Apply by clicking the link below. Remember to submit your application quickly, as we review candidates on an ongoing basis and the advertisement may be taken down before the position has been filled if we have moved on to the selection and interview phase. We do not accept applications by email.

Mycket god kommunikationsförmåga och förmågan att leda ditt projekt och dig själv.

Du har erfarenhet att vårda kundrelationer och driva säljprocesser

Microsoft Certifikat: AZ-104, AZ-305 och AZ-400
IT-Arkitektcertifiering från Dataföreningen eller liknade instans.
Erfarenhet av Cisco och Ubiquitinätverkstekniker

Detta kommer du att göra

Vi arbetar med att möjliggöra våra kunders digitalseringsresor genom att vara djupt tekniska specialister på kundens teknikplattformar, med utgångspunkt i Microsofts ekosystem. Du kommer jobba med kunder som behöver hjälp att flytta upp sina On Premis miljöer till Azure. Du kommer att designa lösningarna utifrån kundens krav och Microsoft well architected framework. Samt hjälpa till att implementera lösningarna.

Vi lägger stor vikt på gemensamma teamleveranser och vi samarbetar ofta med andra team på Accigo. Därför är det viktigt att du trivs med att jobba tillsammans med andra och samtidigt tar ansvar för din egen leverans.

I din roll som Cloud-arkitekt kommer du att agera lösningsarkitekt i våra kunduppdrag, hjälpa till med införsäljning, genomföra externa och interna kompetensutvecklingsinitiativ, design och uppsättning av Azurelösningar, samt hands-on och problemlösning. Du förväntas driva uppdrag och ta stort eget ansvar i dina projekt. Du kommer med din kompetens och branscherfarenhet vara en mycket viktig länk mellan affärsverksamhet och IT-infrastrukturen i Azure.

Vårt team

Vi är ett nyfiket och samarbetsvilligt team, med ett gemensamt brinnande intresse för teknik och digitalisering. Vi ser oss som Sveriges vassaste (och gladaste) team inom våra fokusområden, och har en långsiktig strategi att växa och bli fler. Vi arbetar dagligen med varandra, både i kundleveranser och med erbjudandeutveckling och att driva våra fokusområden.

Förutom att arbeta tillsammans bjuder vi även in till frukostar där vi delar med oss av pinsamheter och udda fakta, kompetensspridning, veckovisa team-träffar och spontana fikastunder. Vi strävar efter att skapa en vardag fylld med spännande projekt och möjligheter hos kund, samt glädje, energi och gemenskap i teamet där dina idéer får ta plats.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Har du några frågor eller är du bara nyfiken? Vi berättar gärna mer om oss över en kaffe: tyra.drakenberg@accigo.se

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

jobs.title: AI & Digital Systems Architect
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are looking for a highly motivated and ambitious AI & Digital Systems Architect to define and govern the architecture required to integrate artificial intelligence into industrial products, engineering workflows, and business processes.

The role connects control systems, edge and cloud platforms, engineering tools, enterprise applications, and governed data foundations to create scalable, secure, reusable, and production-ready AI capabilities. The architect translates business and engineering needs into end-to-end solution blueprints, guides solutions from experimentation to operational deployment, and ensures that model quality, explainability, cybersecurity, human oversight, lifecycle governance, and measurable value are engineered into every AI-enabled capability.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Define and govern end-to-end architectures for AI-enabled products, digital solutions, and engineering workflows across OT, edge, cloud, data, and enterprise environments.
Establish AI architecture standards, reference architectures, reusable design patterns, and best practices for scalable and maintainable solutions.
Partner with business, product, and engineering stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and deliver high-value AI use cases that create measurable business impact.
Drive the integration of AI across engineering, operations, service, and digital processes, from concept and proof of concept through industrialization and adoption.
Architect AI-enabled capabilities for industrial control systems, automation solutions, HMI/SCADA applications, edge devices, and digital products.
Define data, knowledge, and platform architectures leveraging technologies such as data platforms, lakehouses, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and digital twins.
Establish MLOps and LLMOps practices covering deployment, monitoring, testing, evaluation, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of AI solutions.
Ensure AI solutions meet requirements for security, privacy, reliability, explainability, compliance, and responsible AI governance.
Design scalable integration patterns, APIs, and data flows connecting OT systems, engineering tools, enterprise applications, and cloud services.
Act as the technical authority for AI and digital systems architecture, mentoring teams and aligning strategy across software, data, cloud, cybersecurity, and business functions.

Your background

PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in software, systems, data, AI/ML, industrial automation, or other mission-critical digital platforms.
Strong expertise in enterprise and systems architecture, software lifecycle management, data architectures, AI/ML engineering, and industrial automation.
Proven track record of defining end-to-end architectures and delivering AI-enabled solutions from concept and prototyping to scalable production environments.
Hands-on experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agentic AI, and the integration of AI capabilities into applications, platforms, and industrial products.
Deep understanding of AI engineering practices including MLOps/LLMOps, model lifecycle management, evaluation frameworks, observability, governance, explainability, and responsible AI.
Strong background in modern data architectures including data products, pipelines, lakehouse and streaming solutions, time-series data, vector databases, data governance, and lineage.
Experience with cloud-native and distributed architectures, including microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, containers, orchestration, and hybrid or edge deployments.
Knowledge of industrial and enterprise environments, including OT/IT integration, SCADA, HMI, PLC/DCS, digital twins, as well as PLM, ERP, simulation, analytics, and workflow platforms.
Proficiency in Python, modern AI/ML frameworks, and cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP; familiarity with TOGAF, ArchiMate, C4, cybersecurity, data protection, regulatory compliance, and engineering tools such as MATLAB/Simulink or PSCAD is considered an advantage.

jobs.title: Solution Architect inom Business Central - ta en nyckelroll i vårt team
jobs.description:
Vi har byggt upp ett dedikerat Business Central-team – nu söker vi en erfaren Solution Architect som vill vara med och ta oss till nästa nivå.

Vi har redan etablerat vårt nya Business Central-team inom Dynamics 365 och på plats finns idag flera erfarna kollegor som brinner för att skapa värde för våra kunder. För att ytterligare stärka satsningen har vi också rekryterat en dedikerad säljare för området, vilket ger oss en stark plattform för att växa. Det är där du kommer in i bilden.

Vad innebär rollen?

Som Solution Architect Blir Du En Central Del i Att Utveckla Teamet Och Driva Våra Mest Affärskritiska Uppdrag. Du Får Möjlighet Att

Designa och leda lösningsarkitektur för komplexa kundmiljöer
Säkerställa att Business Central används strategiskt och skapar långsiktigt affärsvärde
Vara en rådgivande partner för våra kunder i allt från strategi till implementation
Leda workshops, kravdialoger och omsätta dem i lösningar
Vara mentor och bollplank för kollegor i teamet, både funktionellt och arkitekturmässigt

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har lång erfarenhet av Business Central, gärna med kombinationen av funktionell konsulting och lösningsarkitektur. Du har en djup förståelse för helheten – från finans, inköp och logistik till produktion och integrationer och vet hur modulerna kan samverka för att stärka affärsflöden. Vi ser också framför oss att du har varit delaktig i presale-arbete (meriterande).

Du trivs med att ta en ledande roll, sätta riktning och utmana status quo, samtidigt som du ser till att lösningarna fungerar i praktiken. Här får du både strategiskt ansvar och närhet till leveransen – i ett team som redan har en stabil grund och ambitionen att fortsätta växa.

Eftersom vi arbetar både lokalt och globalt är det viktigt att du är trygg i både svenska och engelska.

Varför ska du jobba hos oss?

Hos oss får du möjlighet att fokusera på det du är allra bäst på – att designa smarta och hållbara Business Central-lösningar som verkligen gör skillnad för våra kunder. Du blir en del av ett dedikerat team där kompetensen redan är hög och där vi bygger vidare tillsammans, med en gemensam ambition att ta vårt erbjudande till nästa nivå.

Här får du kollegor som både utmanar och stöttar dig, som uppskattar din erfarenhet och värdesätter det du bidrar med. Vi tror på samarbete, vi firar våra framgångar och vi har kul längs vägen. Det är så vi skapar både affärsnytta och arbetsglädje.

Ansökan och nästa steg

Hos oss kan du ansöka med din LinkedIn och/eller ditt CV. Du behöver inte skicka in något personligt brev. I vår rekryteringsprocess tar vi alltid referenser och genomför en bakgrundskontroll innan anställning eller eventuellt erbjudande ges. Har du frågor, vänd dig till Alexander Tonelli. Intervjuer kommer hållas löpande.

Jobba på Columbus

Människor kommer alltid först på Columbus. Vi är ett globalt konsultbolag med lokal närvaro, som hjälper företag med deras digitala förändring och att blomstra genom teknik, data och mänsklig insikt. Vi är också är en arbetsplats där du som medarbetare får utveckla din karriär och få stöd genom tydliga och strukturerade karriärvägar.

Vår kultur bygger på tillit, samarbete, nyfikenhet och ett gemensamt engagemang för att leverera värde till våra kunder. Oavsett om du är erfaren eller precis i början av din karriär, kommer du att hitta friheten att utforska idéer, utmana det invanda och forma din egen väg hos oss.

Med över 1 500 kollegor i fler än 10 länder kombinerar vi globala perspektiv med lokal förståelse. Det som förenar oss är vår tro på att skapa en meningsfull påverkan – för våra medarbetare, våra kunder och resan framåt.

Let’s thrive, grow, and shape the future together.

Vi tror att du har några års erfarenhet inom Power Platform antingen internt eller externt i en konsultande roll. Du gillar att jobba tillsammans med andra och kommer bra överens med våra Microsoft Dynamics-specialister.

Vi vill utöka vårat Power Platform-team inom vårt affärsområde Dynamics. Målet är att skapa smarta, skräddarsydda applikationer och automatiserade flöden som stärker vår förmåga att leverera värde till våra kunder. Med det nya teamet vill vi ytterligare förstärka vårt erbjudande 🚀

Att du är nyfiken på att lära dig mer om Power Platform. Du gillar att utveckla och implementera lösningar som faktiskt gör skillnad. Du kommer att få göra det du är bra på, tillsammans med människor som uppskattar både dig och det du gör. Och även om solen lyser med sin frånvaro, så kommer teamet att lysa upp din dag (okej, vi vet att det var lite cheesy, men du fattar vad vi menar). Så, vad säger du?

Drammen
er vår base. Det er stedet hvor vi bygger fagmiljø, fellesskap og kultur. Her skjer det faglige og sosiale: sparring, læring, fagkvelder og gode samtaler over en kaffe.

Backend: C#, .NET og ulike databaseteknologier
Integrasjon: API-er, asynkron kommunikasjon

DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Observability
Kvalitet: Test, Code Reviews
KI: KI-assistert utvikling og agentisk utvikling

Utvikle robuste løsninger i større systemlandskap med tydelige kvalitetskrav
Delta i tekniske beslutninger og arkitekturdiskusjoner (på et nivå som passer rollen/prosjektet)
Jobbe tett med UX/design, sikkerhet, data/plattform og produkt
Bidra til ryddig, lesbar og langsiktig kode, og gode utviklingsprinsipper i teamet
Veilede andre når det er naturlig (f.eks. parprogrammering og kodegjennomgang)

Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ser etter deg som har:
Fullført høyere utdanning innen relevant fagområde
5+ års erfaring som utvikler
God erfaring med C# og .Net
Erfaring med API-design og integrasjoner i moderne systemer
Erfaring med frontend (React/TypeScript eller lignende)
Erfaring med, og trives i, smidige tverrfaglige team

God formidlingsevne på norsk, muntlig og skriftlig (tilsvarende C1)

Send CV eller ta kontakt for å høre mer; vi vurderer søknader fortløpende og gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Omnium develops a 100% cloud-based Order Management System (OMS) that helps businesses consolidate and handle orders from all sales channels; e-commerce, customer service, POS systems and more. Our solution simplifies complex processes and creates a seamless and efficient shopping experience.

We like to call ourselves a start-up with eight years of experience. With some of the Nordics' largest retail and brand players in our customer portfolio and a rapidly growing market, we are well positioned for further expansion. With us, you'll help build a product in strong development – with modern technology, high pace and no legacy.

THE ROLE

As a fullstack developer at Omnium, you'll become part of a cross-functional development team. You'll work closely with a modern SaaS platform built on .NET, with Azure, Elasticsearch and Vue.js, used by some of the Nordics' largest commerce players. You'll work across the stack, from backend to frontend, and take technical ownership of how functionality is designed, built and further developed in production.

This is a domain-heavy role. Our customers are retailers and brands running high volumes across e-commerce, stores and customer service, and their business logic lives in our platform — orders, inventory, fulfilment, returns, payments, channel complexity. Setting up Omnium well means genuinely understanding how each customer operates, so we're looking for someone who recognises these processes from experience and can translate them into solid technical solutions.

HERE YOU'LL GET:

Technical ownership of the development of a complex and modern SaaS platform
Variety between back-end (C#/.NET, integrations, API development) and front-end (Vue.js)
A short path from idea to production in close collaboration with product and design
Significant influence on architecture, technical choices, priorities and how we work as a development team
The opportunity to work in a strong technical team where you actively participate in code reviews and technical discussions, contributing to better code quality, performance and stability

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS

Experience building systems for retail or e-commerce, for example OMS, ERP, e-commerce platforms, POS, WMS, payments or logistics. This is a requirement: you need to understand the commerce domain, not just the code
5+ years of experience as a developer, preferably from SaaS or other complex systems in production
Solid expertise in C# and .NET and experience building robust backend services and APIs
A good understanding of architecture, domain modelling, API design and databases
The ability to make deliberate technical choices based on scalability, performance and maintainability
Experience with modern frontend frameworks is an advantage, ideally Vue.js
Strong communication skills in Norwegian and English, and the ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

WHAT WE OFFER

Influence: Direct influence on architecture, technical choices and priorities, with short paths from technical proposal to decision.
Product and complexity: A modern and rapidly scaling SaaS platform in heavy use, with complex and business-critical problems to solve.
Startup pace, mature platform: We combine high speed and short decision paths with 8 years of experience and a strong customer portfolio.
Flexibility and security: A flexible workday, competitive terms, and solid pension and leave arrangements.
A social and supportive environment: A low threshold for humour, professional sparring and social initiatives, including company trips and events.

ABOUT THE EMPLOYER

At Omnium, we place a high value on collaboration, learning and well-being. We're an engaged team that combines extensive experience with a start-up mentality, and we work together to create an unparalleled product. With us, you'll become part of an environment where we lift each other up and share knowledge, all to ensure both our own and our customers' success.

We have been named one of the 50 fastest-growing tech companies in Norway several years in a row.

Vi ser etter deg som har 2-7 års erfaring med CRM, hvor kompetanse innen Dynamics 365 CE Dynamics 365 CE-applikasjonene (Sales, Customer Insights og Customer Service) er ønskelig, men ikke et krav. Du kombinerer forretningsforståelse med systemkunnskap, trives i dialog med kunder og motiveres av å skape løsninger som gir verdi.

Hos oss blir du en del av et sterkt CRM- og Power Platform miljø med erfarne CRM-spesialister, arkitekter og funksjonelle konsulenter. Du blir en del av Customer & Operations-avdelingen, og ikke minst, en del et av Nordens ledende konsulentmiljøer i med særlig styrke innen transformasjon, teknologi, kundeopplevelser og operasjonell forbedring. Som del av KPMG, får du også muligheten til å jobbe tverrfaglig med kolleger på tvers av kompetanseområder som strategi, teknologi, data, risiko og regulatoriske tjenester for å løse komplekse utfordringer for våre kunder.

Kartlegge kundebehov og omsette disse til funksjonelle løsninger i Dynamics 365
Konfigurere og tilpasse CRM-løsninger
Lede eller bidra i workshops, designprosesser og implementeringsprosjekter
Rådgi kunder om beste praksis innen CRM, kundedata og prosessforbedring
Samarbeide tett med utviklere, arkitekter og andre fagmiljøer

Være en viktig sparringspartner for kunder gjennom hele prosjektløpet, fra idé og kartlegging til implementering og gevinstrealisering

2-7 års erfaring med CRM-løsninger hvor Dynamics 365 er en fordel
Erfaring fra implementering, konfigurering eller videreutvikling av CRM-løsninger
God forståelse for salgs-, markeds- eller serviceprosesser

Som ansatt i KPMG vil du utvikle deg i flere ulike roller hvor du bistår våre kunder med deres problemstillinger. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Channel Services
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building robust, secure and innovative solutions and excited by the possibilities of AI and data-driven development? Channel Services is looking for a Software Engineer to join our team.

About the team:

We are a small, high-impact team
with big responsibility,
we own the full stack for DNB's communication services across web and mobile channels. Working in a BizDevOps model
, we sit at the intersection of business, development and operations, making sure our decisions are driven by both customer needs and technical excellence. With lean structure comes real ownership: every team member has a meaningful voice in how we build, ship and run our services. You'll be joining a tight-knit group where collaboration is close, the work is varied, and your contributions are visible.

What will your day look like?

You'll take end-to-end ownership of what you build, from scoping and specifying requirements together with stakeholders, through design and development, all the way to deployment and production operations. No handoffs, no silos. You'll work across the full backend lifecycle: designing APIs, building services, reviewing incidents and iterating quickly on feedback. Because we're a small team, you'll often be the one driving a feature from the first conversation to the last deploy. You'll collaborate directly with frontend engineers, product owners and business stakeholders to make sure what we ship is both technically sound and genuinely useful.

What kind of developer are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who wants real ownership, not just a ticket to close, but a problem to solve. You're comfortable stepping into ambiguity, asking the right questions, and turning business needs into concrete technical solutions. You take responsibility for the full lifecycle of your work and don't wait for someone else to define the next step. At the same time, you're a team player who communicates openly, shares knowledge, and helps the team grow. You thrive in a small team environment where autonomy and accountability go hand in hand.

Your knowledge and skills:

Strong expertise in Kotlin and Java, with solid knowledge of multithreading, Kotlin Coroutines, and functional Programming
Hands-on experience building and deploying production services on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CDK), with deep understanding of API Gateway, Lambda, SQS, ECS, EC2, VPCs and networking
Proven ability to design, build and operate high-performance, low-latency distributed systems, troubleshooting at scale comes naturally to you
Strong data modelling skills across both SQL (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (DynamoDB)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and a DevOps mindset, you're comfortable owning services end-to-end in production
Familiarity with serverless architectures is a plus
Working knowledge of Go, auth protocols, OPA, Kubernetes and K6 is a significant advantage
Fluent in English, written and verbal; Norwegian is a plus
Relevant higher education or equivalent experience

Work location:
Oslo

What's in it for you?

Challenging tasks that allow you to grow professionally, competitive terms, a strong engineering culture, and good career opportunities. We offer good pension conditions, employee terms on DNBs products, insurance schemes, access to resorts in Norway, sports, cultural and other activities plus a wide range of discount schemes. In addition, knowledge and experiences are our most important assets, so you will have the opportunity to participate in courses and conferences such as JavaZone and NDC, both to build your own competency and to represent DNB externally. We also have flexible working hours, extra days off and reduced working hours from May to August (summertime).

Are you curious about the position, and would like to know more about how it is like to work with us?

For questions about the position, please get in touch with:
Department Manager / Sanel Sarajlija / mail:
sanel.sarajlija@dnb.no / phone:
+47 91827881

A job in Norway's largest financial group offers professional challenges in an exciting work environment with many opportunities. DNB strives to create an inclusive workplace where people thrive and feel comfortable. We believe that equality and inclusion boost innovative thinking and collective competency which contributes to create an attractive and flexible company equipped for a changeable business landscape. We are looking for skilled and motivated employees to meet customer needs and to achieve our goals. With so many varied disciplines and exciting opportunities in the future, we are looking for employees with different background, age and expertise. Are you engaged in focusing on the customer, and in addition fit our values: curious, brave and responsible, you might be exactly the person we need.

Are you ready to build the software that helps medical professionals harness the power of AI? Aiforia is transforming the world of tissue diagnostics and medical image analysis. We equip pathologists and scientists with deep learning AI to improve efficiency and consistency across clinical histopathology of cancer.

Our mission is to provide high-quality, AI-assisted solutions that enable personalized and democratized care for patients. To help us achieve this, we are looking for a driven Software Engineer to build and improve the products that bring our AI to clinical and research users.

Role and responsibilities

As a core member of our engineering team, you will work across the full stack, from back-end services to the web applications our customers use every day. You will help expand Aiforia's platform and keep our existing products robust and reliable.

Your key tasks will include:

Architecture and design: Design scalable, robust solutions across the stack, from back-end services and APIs to user-facing web features.
Software implementation: Develop, write, and optimize production-level code across the stack.
AI tooling and context: Write and maintain the specifications, repository context, and prompts that make AI workflows possible.
Quality assurance: Ensure high standards of code quality and reliability through code reviews, unit tests, and validation protocols.
Technical documentation: Write and maintain clear, accurate technical documentation to support development, regulatory compliance, and cross-team collaboration.
Product maintenance: Monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain existing products to ensure seamless performance for our users in clinical and research settings.

Who we are looking for

The ideal candidate is a versatila engineer who is comfortable moving between back-end front-end work. You write clean dove, care about the end user, and thrive in a collaborative, mission-driven environment.

Requirements:

Educational background: BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related field.
Experience: 3+ years of relevant industry experience in full-stack or software engineering.
Technical skills: Strong programming skills and hands-on experience building and deploying web applications and back-end services in production.
Communication: Excellent teamwork and communication skills. Fluency in written and spoken English is a must.
AI-assisted development: Daily hands-on use of AI coding tools in production work. You can explain the role of agents and context in the development workflow, and how you verify the result.

What gives you an edge:

Experience and knowledge of image analysis and AI model building, and the workflows associated with them, including data management, verification metrics, and validation.
Experience building and evolving an AI harness: the infrastructure around the development process that lets agents operate as independent actors across the delivery lifecycle.
Experience improving how a team adopts AI coding tools: shared context, execution loops, and safety boundaries.
Experience with our core stack: C#/.NET.
Experience with modern front-end frameworks (e.g. React, Angular, TypeScript).
Familiarity with REST APIs, databases, and cloud computing platforms.
Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, and DevOps practices.
Previous experience working with medical devices, healthcare data, or within regulated environments (e.g. ISO 13485, FDA).

What we offer

Innovation: A chance to work at the forefront of medical AI technologies and make a real impact on patient care.
Culture: Join a supportive, enthusiastic, and multidisciplinary team of experts who are passionate about what they do.
Growth: Real opportunities for professional and career development in one of the fastest-growing sectors of health tech.

Location

Helsinki, Finland. We offer a hybrid work model that provides flexibility for your daily life. However, we hope that you will work primarily from our office during the initial stage of your employment. This ensures you receive the best possible support, a smooth onboarding experience, and the opportunity to truly get to know your team from day one.

Please note: We are unable to sponsor visas for this position.

How to apply

Are you the person we are looking for? Please, send your application by October 13, 2026 through careers.aiforia.com.
For data privacy reasons, we only accept applications submitted via the portal.
Please include a portfolio or work samples showcasing your design process and past projects.
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis prior to the deadline, so please submit yours as soon as possible.

Before you apply: Please read Aiforia's Privacy Policy for Job Applicants before submitting your application.

jobs.title: Cloud Architect (Azure)
jobs.description:
Grow. Make a difference. Together.

We want to help our clients understand why cloud services can support their growth and how to embark on a sustainable cloud journey. Our strong Azure expertise, combined with our highest-level Microsoft partnership, enables us to act as a long-term and trusted partner to our customers, helping them develop their cloud services securely, efficiently and with cost optimization in mind.

We are now looking to strengthen our team of Azure professionals with an Azure Architect
and invite you to join us in building a sustainable future! Sustainability is one of our core principles, and we have, for example, signed the Microsoft Partner Pledge.

As an Azure Architect, you will design, implement, maintain and continuously develop new and sustainable cloud services for a wide range of customers. Our clients include major organisations such as Valmet, S Group and Varma (customer case).

What is the role about?

We are looking for an Azure Architect with strong expertise and experience particularly in Kubernetes solutions. In this role, you will take the lead in designing and implementing demanding container solutions using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
, ensuring that they are scalable, secure and reliable.

A key part of the role is also strategically planning future technology directions, designing environments that support evolving business needs, and driving innovation through new cloud technologies. You will play an important role in developing business continuity and resilience solutions tailored to container-based applications, guiding smooth migrations and optimising system performance for both current and future needs.

In this key role, you will work with a diverse range of clients across different industries, providing both strategic direction and technical leadership in using container technologies to transform their businesses.

As a professional at Knowit, you will have every opportunity to put your expertise to use while continuing to develop your skills with the latest modern technologies. We encourage experimentation and trying new things, and you can steer the development of your expertise in the direction that best supports your growth as a cloud professional.

Building service solutions based on Microsoft Azure cloud architectures covers the entire journey, from definition and design to development and deployment. You will work as part of client teams alongside other experienced Azure professionals, right at the intersection of technology and our clients’ businesses.

What do we expect from you?

At Knowit, we are all makers at heart: we keep our promises and approach our work with passion. We are proud of our broad expertise and take pride in what we do. Being a consultant at Knowit can be summarized as follows

The ability to present and communicate ideas, best practices, and technical solutions to various stakeholders—from development teams to non-technical audiences.
The ability to see technologies as tools for solving technical problems and delivering value.
A built-in curiosity to learn new things, experiment with new technologies and practices, develop professionally, and share knowledge with others.

In addition to the maker mindset, we expect you to have a genuine interest in the technical side of Azure. One thing all our Azure professionals have in common is the ability and willingness to do hands-on technical work when needed. You are also able to communicate fluently and confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in English
.

We hope you have:

3–5 years of experience with Azure cloud services. This means an interest in designing and defining architectures and/or strong expertise in implementing them. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is our preferred way of working.
3–5 years of experience in container orchestration, preferably in an Azure environment, particularly in designing, developing, deploying, maintaining and troubleshooting container-based applications and their architectures using technologies such as Kubernetes and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
A DevOps mindset: you understand modern approaches to building solutions using native tools and code, and actively look for opportunities to automate everything from infrastructure to business logic.
Strong expertise in designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines for container-based applications, including Azure Container Registry integrations and the use of Helm package management.
Experience in implementing and managing security practices in Kubernetes environments, such as network policies and security contexts, as well as a good understanding of Azure security tools such as Defender for Cloud.

Skills that are considered an advantage, but are not required:

Experience with Kubernetes monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
Ingress controllers and Gateway API
Azure DevOps and GitHub
Infrastructure as Code experience with Azure Bicep
Experience with GitOps tools such as FluxCD and ArgoCD
AI policies, AI Gateway and MCP servers

What do we offer you?

At Knowit, we value broad expertise as well as the willingness to explore and master new areas. We take pride in our hands-on way of working and our deep technical expertise.

And because we don't want this to be just a one-sided wish list, we want you to have the opportunity to shape your role as an expert and take ownership of your professional development, with our support. Everyone is welcome to be their whole self at Knowit, and we consider a relaxed yet professional working community valuable in its own right.

Here’s what we offer:

A fixed monthly salary of 5000 – 6600€, depending on your skills, experience and capabilities.
A team and community where it is easy to grow and get support when you need it. Our people are at different stages of their careers, and we offer opportunities that challenge and develop both recent graduates and more experienced professionals.
Our People Lead model, which has received a lot of positive feedback internally. We believe that a manager's most important responsibility is to ensure that you, as an expert, have the best possible conditions to succeed in your work and develop professionally.
Time and resources to develop your expertise during working hours, including training, certifications and guild activities. We want to invest in your professional development.
Opportunities for internal mobility. Your work can make an impact across several industries, and working with different customers gives you genuine opportunities to learn something new.
A technology-independent environment. We work with modern technologies, tools and best practices, and have strong technology partnerships with major players in the industry. At the same time, we remain curious, ready to learn new things and willing to challenge the status quo.
Flexible remote and hybrid working arrangements that adapt to different life situations.
An excellent work-life balance. We work on large and meaningful projects in sustainable digitalization, but we also recognize that everyone is a whole person and that there is more to everyday life than work.
A comprehensive range of employee benefits, including lunch, commuting and sports/culture benefits, extensive occupational healthcare, accident insurance, work equipment of your choice, recruitment and sales lead bonuses, and the possibility of temporarily working remotely from abroad.

Interested?

If what you’ve read above resonates with your professional interests and you recognize yourself in the description, we would be very happy to hear more about you!

If you have any questions or would like to have a quick chat before making your decision, please contact our Talent Acquisition Partner, Topias Niinivaara
, whose contact details can be found on our careers site.

Knowit - We are Makers of a sustainable future

Our work community in Finland consist of over 400 IT professionals and management consultants in Helsinki, Tampere, Turku, and Oulu. Our working culture consists of low hierarchies, relaxed and open atmosphere and moreover, of great people.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

We are looking for a Software Engineering Specialist to contribute to the development of clinical application software for patient monitoring products.

In this software engineering role, you will work as part of a multi-disciplinary agile team developing software that helps clinicians monitor patients and make timely care decisions. The work includes designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining application software for patient monitors, including visualization of physiological measurements, alarms, trends, statuses, graphics, and reliable data transfer within the system and to external networks.

You will learn and apply modern software engineering practices in a regulated medical device environment, with support from experienced engineers and the wider team. The role includes responsible use of Generative AI tools as part of the software development workflow to support productivity, learning, code quality, testing, documentation, and everyday engineering work.

This is a great opportunity for an early-career software engineer who is curious, collaborative, quality-minded, and eager to grow in health technology.

Responsibilities

Job Description

Design, implement, test, and maintain clinical application software for patient monitoring products as part of an agile software development team.
Develop software features related to visualization of medical measurements, including numbers, waveforms, statuses, trends, graphics, alarms, and measurement data transfer within the system and to external networks.
Contribute to feature development under the guidance of more experienced engineers, gradually building technical ownership of defined tasks and smaller feature areas.
Apply modern software engineering methods, tools, and practices to develop robust, maintainable, and high-quality software that meets the expectations of the medical device industry.
Participate actively in design reviews, code reviews, testing, defect analysis, and required documentation.
Write and maintain unit tests and other automated tests and contribute to improving testability and software quality.
Use AI coding assistants responsibly as part of daily software engineering work, for example in ticket investigation, code generation, test creation, documentation, refactoring, debugging, and learning, in accordance with company policies.
Work as an active member of a collaborative, multi-disciplinary agile team, contributing to shared goals and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with software engineers, testers, clinical experts, system engineers, and other stakeholders in a cross-functional, multi-cultural, and global environment.
Continuously build technical skills, product understanding, and knowledge of software development in a regulated healthcare environment.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent field.
Hands-on experience or solid academic/project background in object-oriented software design and development, preferably with C++.
Basic understanding of modern software development practices, agile ways of working, and software quality activities such as reviews, testing, and documentation.
Experience or interest in application software, user interface development, embedded software, or software platforms.
Willingness to learn and use AI coding assistants responsibly as part of everyday software development work.
Demonstrated engineering curiosity, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Self-starter attitude—eager and quick to learn, experiment, ask questions, and grow.
Ability and willingness to work collaboratively with team members to achieve shared goals.
Growth mindset with commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
Fluency in English, both spoken and written.
Legally authorized to work in Finland.

Desired Qualifications

Experience or coursework related to technologies used in medical or embedded software systems, such as Linux, RTOS, Qt/QML, embedded systems, configuration management, continuous integration, test automation, or Python.
Experience with user interface development, especially Qt/QML.
Basic understanding of multithreaded programming or interest in learning concurrency concepts.
Experience working with a larger code base through studies, internships, thesis work, open-source projects, or professional experience.
Interest in physiological measurements, clinical workflows, patient monitoring, or healthcare technology.
Interest in software development for safety-critical, regulated, or high-quality product environments.

We offer

Work for a great purpose—your work will help improve patient care and save lives.
A unique opportunity to learn and develop leading-edge health technologies and products.
Supportive colleagues and a team with great spirit.
Opportunity to learn from talented experts in the health technology industry.
Access to world-class processes, tools, and professionals across different functions.
A diverse, multi-cultural working environment where you can contribute and grow.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
Regular technical and soft skills learning opportunities to build your knowledge and skills.
Possibility to grow your skills and abilities to support future roles in the organization, including technical and managerial career paths.
Flexible working hours in a hybrid mode, combining remote work and office work.
Office near Pasila railway station in central Helsinki with own on-site parking, gym, café, and restaurant.

Interested?

For further information, please contact Software Engineering Manager Pauli Salokoski (pauli.salokoski(at)gehealthcare.com, +358-50-586 5686).

Our hybrid working model

We seek a new colleague to join our talented Technology team based at our Copenhagen office.

At AutoProff, we believe great technology drives great experiences - and we’re just getting started. We’re on a mission to transform the way vehicles are traded across Europe, and we need curious and driven new colleagues to help us do it.

As our new Software Engineer, you’ll join a cross-functional team focused on the Fulfillment & FinTech domain, where we build and evolve critical post-trade services in a B2B environment. Our team owns key capabilities such as logistics orchestration, transport partner integrations, payment touchpoints, invoicing visibility, and claims handling, ensuring seamless and transparent operations after a transaction is completed. Working closely with product, operations, and external partners, you’ll help design and deliver robust, scalable solutions that connect multiple systems and stakeholders, directly impacting the efficiency and reliability of our platform for customers across Europe.

We foster a developer-friendly culture where innovation isn’t just encouraged, it’s expected. You’ll have access to modern, AI-powered tools to enhance productivity and streamline your daily work. We host hackathons to explore new tech, ideas and tools, and our internal developer forums are open spaces for discussing architecture, new technologies, and tough engineering challenges. Whether building or learning, there's always room to experiment and grow.

Let's dive into your key responsibilities, you will

Work in a dynamic and international environment with experienced and skilled colleagues
Design, develop, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code using engineering best practices and design patterns.
Drive a culture of “you build it - you own it” - mentality
Identify and act on areas for your own personal development
Mentor and coach co-workers on topics that you master.

The need-to-have skills

Proven ability to thrive in environments that value adaptability, shared ownership, and continuous improvement
Experience working with .NET and C#
Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, distributed systems and event-driven architecture.
Experience with relational databases or No-SQL databases
Good communication skills and fluency in business English (spoken and written)
Open towards and able to quickly learn new technologies
Ability to troubleshoot problems, debug and suggest solutions

The nice-to-have skills

Experience working with AWS Infrastructure or other cloud providers, especially containerization and serverless computing.
Experience with RESTful APIs

We’re eager to hear from you! If this sounds like a great match and sparks your interest, don’t wait, apply today!

AutoProff was founded 2013 in Denmark with the aim to digitise B2B used car trading, helping car dealers increase sales and improve profits.
