At AutoProff, we specialise in providing online B2B used-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.

We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually.

With a focus on effective solutions, digitisation and customer service, we are committed to being the home of B2B car dealing for European car dealers.

Dine opgaver:

De daglige opgaver kredser sig primært omkring:
Drive og videreudvikle vores Kubernetes-platform: deploye, opgradere og operere clusters.
Automatisk skalering (autoscaling) af VMs og containere baseret på load.
Infrastructure as Code med Kubernetes samt GitOps, GitHub Actions og CI/CD.
Automatisere manuelt arbejde frem for at akkumulere manuelle driftsopgaver — herunder med AI-værktøjer, hvor det giver mening.
Være med til at forbedre vores udviklingsproces med AI-værktøjer og sætte de rette guard rails omkring dem.
Observability og monitorering for at forbedre både performance og stabilitet.
Have blik for omkostninger og effektivitet (FinOps) — ikke kun oppetid.
Sikkerhed: håndtering af secrets, netværkssegmentering og kryptering, både at-rest og in-transit.
Bidrage til teamets kvalitet igennem team-ritualer, reviews, tests og refactoring.

Vi er i gang med en større modernisering af vores cloud platform, og her spiller du en nøglerolle:
Migrere databaser — mellem forskellige hosts og i visse tilfælde fra én teknologi til en anden.
Migrere fra .NET Framework 4.x til moderne .NET 10: SDK-style projekter og modernisering af afhængigheder.
Dekomponere monolitter og store databaser til mindre services og databaser.
Andre opgaver på platformens udvikling.

Hvad vi leder efter:

En engageret og nysgerrig platformsudvikler, med en god portion gå-på-mod og stærke evner.
En team-player, der er service-minded og deler gavmildt ud af sin viden — både over for kolleger i og uden for eget team.
God erfaring med Kubernetes operations: deploy, opgradering og drift af clusters.
Godt kendskab til Linux, netværk og security groups/firewalls (private netværk, egress control, NAT/edge). Kendskab til Windows Server er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
Erfaring med moderne cloud-native platforme og infrastructure-as-code værdsættes højt.
Gode evner i .NET, C#, databaser og API'er er et plus, men ikke et hårdt krav — du er stadig udvikler i bund og grund. Andre teknologier i vores stak er bl.a. SQL Server, Redis, RabbitMq, Elastic og uCommerce/Umbraco.
En automatiseringsfokuseret tilgang: du løser tilbagevendende opgaver med automatisering frem for manuelt arbejde
Interesse for at være med til at forme, hvordan vi som team bruger AI-værktøjer i udviklingsprocessen, herunder de guard rails der skal til for at gøre det sikkert og ansvarligt.
En pragmatisk og inkrementel tilgang: du kan modernisere løbende, sideløbende med roadmap og feature-udvikling — ikke ved at fryse alt andet.
Kritisk tænkende og interesseret i fortsat forbedring af både hvad vi laver og hvordan vi laver det. Du kan både løse komplekse opgaver selvstændigt og hjælpe resten af teamet med at forbedre vores system.

Vi tilbyder:

En vigtig rolle i et firma hvor din stemme kan høres.
En spændende arbejdsplads med høj medarbejdertilfredshed, hvor de mange fagligheder i pharma, e-commerce, warehouse, og tech, arbejder sammen for en fælles sag.
Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både personligt og fagligt.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi finder den rette kandidat.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling med reference til Engineering Manager, Jacob Bonde Larsen. Din arbejdsplads vil hovedsageligt være i Greve, men med fleksibilitet til at arbejde nogle dage på vores lokation i København eller hjemme.

This is a place where you can grow as an individual, learn from senior mentors, and have a real influence on the direction of our projects.
About the team: 

You will be joining a brand new team being built within the Trust Tech department, focusing specifically on businesses.
The team is responsible for building and maintaining automated systems that enforce Trustpilot’s terms of use for businesses. This includes developing systems for automatic detection, enforcement of misuse, and internal investigation tools.
This work is vital to maintaining Trust and Transparency on the platform. To achieve this, we collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Data Ops, and ML Ops to build sophisticated automated architectures that integrate detection models and robustly scale our misuse enforcement.
What you’ll be doing:

Work in a cross-functional “full ownership” team alongside Product, Design, and Data Science.
Implement and release new features with a focus on backend stability and scalability.
Help build solutions to handle high-volume data processing for fraud detection.
Maintain and improve the internal tooling frontends (React) used for investigations.
Troubleshoot existing software, squash bugs, and learn how to optimize database performance.
Participate in technical discussions and learn best practices for Infrastructure as Code.
Collaborate with Data Scientists to support the integration of detection models.

Experience in full-stack web development (commercial experience or a strong portfolio), with a focus on backend systems.
Solid knowledge of JavaScript and TypeScript.
Solid understanding of backend development with Node.js.
Understanding of SQL (e.g., PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB) database concepts.

A friendly, helpful personality, open to giving and receiving feedback constructively.
Ambitious and passionate about your work, motivated to continually improve.

A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
Competitive compensation package + bonus
25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated) 
Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York. 
We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas. 
Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.
Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

jobs.title: Delivery Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About The Delivery Engineer Team

As a member of the Delivery Engineer team, you will own the post-sales onboarding and data health for customers. Your goal will be to drive data trust, help embed Mixpanel into our customers’ data stack, and deliver on emerging AI integrations — delivering on the full value of Mixpanel as a self-serve analytics platform. You will work and consult with GTM team members and a diverse array of customers to successfully roll out product analytics to their organization and execute on technical projects and services that delight our customers.

About The Role

As a Delivery Engineer, you will be on the front lines with our clients as they integrate Mixpanel into their core product development processes. You will lay the foundation for customers to adopt product analytics and get value from Mixpanel by delivering a world-class, on-time, and value-oriented onboarding experience. With your comprehensive project management knowledge, consultative approach, expertise in the analytics space, and technical knowledge of the modern data stack, you will lead our clients' first experience with Mixpanel as they incorporate product analytics into their data ecosystem as a foundational element. With your deep technical breadth and expertise in the analytics space, you’ll be the expert consultant on all things data and ecosystem. As Mixpanel and our customers continue to iterate on agentic integrations, you’ll own ensuring customers are able to build, assemble context, and integrate AI workflows.

Responsibilities

Own onboarding and data health for our strategic and high-value clients, including ongoing enhancements to their data quality and overall tech stack integration
Align with pre-sales teams and consult with prospects/clients to define business goals and metrics to guide data architecture and project outcomes
Engage with customers’ engineering, product management, and marketing teams to handle technical onboarding, optimize Mixpanel deployments, and improve data trust
Deliver a variety of technical services ranging from data architecture consultations to adoption and change management best practices
Leverage modern data architecture expertise to create scalable data governance practices and data trust for our customers, including data optimization and re-implementation projects
Successfully execute on deliverables whilst balancing project timelines, scope creep, and unanticipated issues
Collaborate with our technical and solutions partners as needed on data optimization and onboarding projects
Be a technical sponsor for internal engagements with product and engineering teams to prioritize product and systems tasks from clients
Build AI automations to help customers manage their data at scale
Consult with customers on integrating their agentic workflows with Mixpanel data.

We're Looking For Someone Who Is

Comfortable with data querying, modeling, and transforming in at least one core tool, including SQL / dbt / Python / Business Intelligence tools / Product Analytics tools, etc.
Familiar with databases and cloud data warehouses like Google Cloud, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Azure, etc.
Familiar with product analytics implementation methods like SDKs, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Event Streaming, Reverse ETL, etc.
Familiar with analytics best practices across business segments and verticals
Can manage complex projects with assorted client stakeholders, working across teams and departments to execute real change while managing scope and timelines
Has embedded AI into their workflows and is familiar with using MCP servers, building new skills, setting context, and can credibly consult with our customers about their AI/data strategy
Has experience in customer success, client-facing professional services, consulting, or technical project management role
Excellent written, analytical, and communication skills
Strong process and/or project delivery discipline
Eager to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving customer needs

Benefits And Perks

Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care
Mental Wellness Benefit
Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays
Enhanced Parental Leave
Volunteer Time Off
Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break
please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.
Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.
One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.
Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.
Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.
Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. jobs.description:
Job Description

Stefanini Group is seeking an experienced Network Technical Architect to join our Hybrid Cloud & Infrastructure (HCI) cluster, within the Infrastructure Services Division.

The successful candidate will design and implement secure, resilient enterprise network solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, covering SASE, ZTNA, next-generation firewalls, SD-WAN, and complex routing.

This role combines presales support for solutioning with extensive hands-on implementation and acts as the last level of support for operational teams. It may include occasional travelling and direct technical discussions with vendors.

Job Responsibilities:

Solution Design and Implementation: Architect, deploy, and migrate enterprise network solutions end to end, including SASE, ZTNA, next-generation firewalls, SD-WAN, and campus and data center networks, remaining hands-on from day 1.
Presales Support: Act as the technical authority in presales engagements, qualifying requirements, designing target architectures, estimating effort, and contributing to RFP/RFI responses, proposals, and customer presentations.
Complex Routing and Cloud Networking: Design and implement complex routing environments (BGP, OSPF, route redistribution, traffic engineering) and cloud networking architectures in AWS and Azure, including hybrid connectivity.
Operational Escalation: Act as the last level of support for operational teams, leading root cause analysis and resolution of the most complex network and security incidents.
Vendor Engagement: Drive technical discussions with vendors and technology partners, including product evaluations, proof of concepts, roadmap reviews, and support escalations.
Documentation and Standards: Produce high-level and low-level designs, migration plans, and operational runbooks; define network standards, reference architectures, and best practices.
Training and Development: Provide training, coaching, and structured knowledge transfer to operational teams and clients on new network technologies and practices.
Continuous Improvement: Continuously evaluate and improve network architectures and strategies to adapt to changing technologies and business needs.

Job Requirements

At least 10 years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating enterprise networks in complex, multi-vendor environments
At least 5 years of experience as a network architect, owning end-to-end solution design for large-scale enterprise environments.
Demonstrated ability to perform hands-on implementation from day 1, combining architecture responsibilities with direct configuration and deployment work.
Preferred: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Mandatory: Minimum high school diploma (or equivalent). Bachelor's degree in any field with equivalent professional experience relevant for the job.

Technical Skills:

Expert-level knowledge of routing and switching in complex environments, including BGP, OSPF,route redistribution, and traffic engineering.
Deep hands-on experience with next-generation firewalls (e.g., Fortinet FortiGate, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point), covering design, implementation, upgrades, and migrations.
Strong hands-on experience with SASE and ZTNA solutions (e.g., FortiSASE, Zscaler, Netskope,Prisma Access), from architecture through rollout and day-2 operations.
Proven experience designing and deploying SD-WAN solutions (e.g., Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN, VMware VeloCloud).
Solid experience with cloud networking in AWS and/or Azure, including VPC/VNet design, Transit Gateway, Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute/Direct Connect, and hybrid connectivity.
Strong understanding of network security concepts, including segmentation, IPsec and SSL VPN, IDS/IPS, and Zero Trust principles.
Mandatory 3 years of experience acting as technical project lead, driving the technical discussions with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
Knowledge of network automation and scripting (e.g., Python, Ansible, REST APIs) is considered a plus.

Soft Skills

Proficiency in English for professional communication and documentation.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and multitasking skills capable of handling a vast variety of systems.
Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to stay effective under pressure during critical incidents and escalations
Client Orientation & Communication
Accountability
Adapting & responding to chang
Teamwork & cooperation

per month (Gross in USD)

Hiring Manager:
Matthew Sedlacek

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer with accounting and financial experience. This role offers an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for leadership and innovation.

This position is ideal for professionals who began their careers in accounting or finance and later transitioned into software engineering — individuals who now want to leverage that domain expertise to architect and scale technical solutions that solve complex financial challenges in fintech.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize high-impact systems that power Sezzle’s financial reporting, reconciliation, and automation workflows. You’ll partner closely with cross-functional teams — including Accounting and Finance — to ensure data integrity, streamline financial processes, and build robust, auditable systems that meet enterprise-grade standards.

Your role will extend beyond development. You’ll mentor engineers, shape technical direction, and bring a strong sense of ownership to every project you lead. You should be able to build high-quality, innovative, and fully performing software in compliance with coding standards, technical design, and regulatory best practices.

Compensation
:

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500
USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

Application submitted (you are here)
Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
Coding assessment (:1.5 hours)
Interview with recruiters (30 min)
Interview with engineers (1 hour)
Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
Offer!

What You'll Do:

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance and maintain software solutions for financial processes.
Participate fully in the software development lifecycle, from design through deployment.
Build new features and products as part of an integrated engineering team.
Leverage accounting background to identify gaps and improve automation and reconciliation workflows.
Evaluate and deploy software tools, processes, and metrics.
Provide support and consulting on software systems usage.
Ensure compliance with project plans and industry standards.
Design software applications and features in Golang
Build reports and automations using Python and SQL.
Help build out a distributed architecture, creating solutions that work within it, maintaining consistency while scaling highly
Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products
Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products
Deliver high-quality, testable features that meet reporting and compliance standards.
Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

What We Look For:

At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience
Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward
Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go and Java Python or a similar language.
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

Prior experience as an accountant or financial analyst.
Solid understanding of financial operations such as reconciliation, reporting, and compliance.
Experience in banking or financial institutions is a plus
Proficient in multiple programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and experience with database systems like MySQL or PostgreSQL.
Familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes.
Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications

About You:

You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
Backend: Golang
Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
Version Control: Git
CI/CD: Gitlab
Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Overview

Who are we?

CBTW is a global tech solutions company. We empower businesses with tailored tech and business solutions that drive innovation and sustainable growth.

With over 2500 experts across 21 countries, we deliver results through flexible engagement models like: whether augmenting teams, managing complex projects, or building long-term operations.

Thanks to our 5 service lines, we specialize in:

AI & Data Platforms,
Cloud & Enterprise Platforms,
Cybersecurity,
Software Engineering,
Strategy, Product & Transformation.

More info on our website: https://cbtw.tech/

What service line will you be part of?

As a Cloud Architect, you will join our Cloud & Enterprise Platforms service line.

Cloud & Enterprise Platforms is CBTW's service line dedicated to designing, operating, and optimising the technology foundations that modern organisations rely on, from cloud infrastructure and developer platforms to enterprise collaboration and service management ecosystems.

We help our clients take control of their cloud environments, modernise their platforms, and maximise the value of their enterprise tooling.

Our clients rely on us to:

Migrate and modernise infrastructure across hybrid and multi-cloud environments,
Automate software delivery through DevOps, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code,
Build, secure, and govern API landscapes,
Ensure reliability and full visibility through SRE and observability practices,
Structure, govern, and optimise Atlassian platforms,
Embed AI-powered automation into cloud and collabora tion platforms.

Responsibilities

What will you do?

You will play a critical role in shaping the strategic direction and operational excellence across four key solutions: DevOps & infrastructure, Cloud Managed Services, SRE & Observability, and API Ops.

You will design, implement, and oversee the technical solutions that drive our business forward. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to create scalable, secure, and efficient systems while focusing on modern cloud architecture, API management, integration, and observability. You’ll lead a team of professionals, drive innovation and deliver solutions for our European customers.

Solution Design and Architecture
Design end-to-end technical solutions leveraging cloud-native architectures (AWS and/or Azure).
Architect scalable and secure microservices-based systems to meet business and technical requirements.
Implement best practices for system design, ensuring resilience, scalability, observability and maintainability.
API Management and Integration
Develop and manage strategies for API Gateways and API Operations (API Ops).
Ensure seamless integration across platforms, services, and third-party applications.
Implement robust API lifecycle management, including design, testing, monitoring, and deprecation.
Observability and Monitoring
Define and implement observability strategies to monitor system health, performance, and reliability.
Use tools like Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent to track metrics, logs, and traces across services.
Ensure proactive identification and resolution of performance bottlenecks and system issues.
DevOps and Automation
Collaborate with DevOps teams to establish CI/CD pipelines for automated builds, testing, and deployment.
Drive infrastructure as code (IaC) practices using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar.
Ensure secure and efficient cloud infrastructure provisioning and maintenance.
Collaboration and Leadership
Act as a technical advisor to engineering teams, ensuring alignment with architectural best practices.
Work closely with stakeholders to define technical requirements and translate them into actionable solutions.
Mentor and guide engineering teams in adopting modern architectural and operational practices.

Qualifications

What are we looking for?

Technical Skills

Cloud Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure) and designing scalable, cost-efficient solutions.
API Gateways & API Ops: Strong knowledge of API design, gateways (e.g. Kong, AWS API Gateway), and API lifecycle management.
Integration: Expertise in system integration using middleware, APIs, and event-driven architectures.
Observability: Proficiency in observability tools like Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or similar.
DevOps: Solid experience with CI/CD pipelines, IaC tools (Terraform, Ansible, etc.), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
Microservices: In-depth understanding of microservices patterns, service mesh (e.g., Istio), and distributed systems.

Experience

Minimum of 8 years of experience in Cloud solution architecture, with at least 3 years in management & leadership roles.
Proven experience designing and implementing large-scale distributed systems.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycles and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal with fluency in English, proficiency in French or Dutch.
Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.
Ability to work collaboratively across teams and influence stakeholders.

Certifications

Certification in cloud platforms (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect, etc.)

What are we offering?

EVOLUTION:

A career development expert will follow up on your professional path within the company and support you in shaping and growing your career,
Catalogue with a wide variety of trainings for hard and soft skills, private language classes, unlimited access to an E-learning platform (Udemy, Code Academy... ) and possibility to get certified every year,
Training days credits.

COLLABORATION:

You will join a community of [job title] experts where colleagues support each other on projects, share knowledge through workshops and events to keep learning and evolving, and build international connections, while also enjoying great moments and drinks together,
Participate in internal projects to innovate and develop our solutions portfolio,
Join one of our collectives (Wellness, Agile, RSE, Gaming ...) and share your interests with other positive thinkers,
You’ll also enjoy several unforgettable company parties throughout the year. Events that CBTW has truly mastered the art of organizing.

ON TOP OF THAT:

The Gametech Innovation team
is a specialized group of developers focused on empowering Gameloft’s game teams to create better games through innovative technological solutions. We focus on Unity and Unreal engines, developing tools and systems that span a wide range of game development needs.

As a Mid-Level Developer
within the team, you will manage feature delivery and support the technical stability of our tools and systems, contributing to the full lifecycle of each solution.

What it means on a daily basis

Own features or subsystems end-to-end, from benchmarking existing solutions and prototyping alternatives through to implementing and shipping the final tool to game teams
Write maintainable, self-explanatory code in C++ and C# within Unreal and Unity engines
Debug and profile tools and systems across engines and target platforms (console, PC, mobile) so they stay reliable in production
Maintain and extend the team's CI/CD and build pipelines so new tool versions reach game teams continuously
Use AI coding assistants in your daily workflow, experiment with new approaches and technologies, and propose the incremental improvements worth industrialising

What success will look like

In your first three months, you will be at ease in the team's codebase and delivering fixes and features on existing tools with limited guidance. From there, you will own a feature or subsystem end-to-end, you will propose improvements to tools and workflows on your own initiative and become a technical point of contact for the game teams we support.

Who you would be working with

You will be reporting to our Gametech Innovation Manager, and collaborate very closely with other Developers from the Gametech Innovation team across multiple studios worldwide, including Paris, Montreal, Bucharest, and others, offering opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and perspectives. Day to day you will work with game programmers, technical artists and producers on Gameloft's game teams internationally.

Your recruitment journey

First interview: A conversation to explore how the role aligns with your background and to address your main questions.
Test: You will receive a short case study to complete.
Second interview: You will meet members of our technical team to present your test and talk through your approach, reasoning, and methodologies in more depth.
Final interview: You will meet a Hiring Manager to discuss your experience, vision, and how you approach game technology topics at a broader level.

Where this role can take you

This role can be a stepping stone toward a more senior position within the Gametech Innovation team, or toward specialising in a particular area such as engine, pipeline or platform technology. Internal training and mentoring from the team's senior developers are available, and internal mobility across teams and studios is possible through Gameloft's Talent Move programme.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Solid proficiency with Unreal Engine and/or Unity; and in C++ and C#
Practical use of AI coding assistants in your day-to-day development work
Good debugging and profiling skills across multiple systems, together with the ability to write clean, maintainable and self-explanatory code
Working knowledge of CI/CD and build pipelines

WHO YOU ARE

Naturally curious: you enjoy digging into unfamiliar problems and exploring new engines, tools and approaches
Solution-driven: you turn ambiguous, poorly defined requests into workable technical paths, treat constraints as problems to solve, and propose improvements beyond your assigned scope to keep the team moving forward

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU​

Permanent contract, full-time employment with comprehensive Social Benefits.
25 vacation days per year + Birthday day off.

Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
Free language courses.
Work-from-home hybrid model.
Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description:
Tu misión en Netquest

Buscamos incorporar a nuestro equipo a un/a Ingeniero/a de QA de nivel intermedio/senior
, con experiencia y una actitud muy proactiva. En este puesto, serás responsable de diseñar, crear y mantener frameworks de automatización de pruebas, identificar riesgos de producto y riesgos técnicos, mejorar nuestra estrategia de testing y trabajar estrechamente con desarrolladores, product managers y equipo de DevOps para prevenir los problemas en lugar de limitarse a detectarlos.

Este puesto es ideal para una persona que se desenvuelva bien en entornos colaborativos, que se anticipe a los retos antes de que surjan y que impulse las buenas prácticas en automatización y estrategias de testing.

Trabajarás en un producto digital de investigación de mercados disponible en tres plataformas: Android, iOS y extensiones de navegador.

¿Qué buscamos en ti?

Tus responsabilidades:

Investigación y reporte de defectos: Identificar, reproducir, investigar y documentar claramente los defectos, incluyendo su impacto, pasos para reproducirlos, logs/evidencias y el contexto técnico (JIRA). Colaborar con los desarrolladores para llevar las incidencias hasta su resolución y evitar que vuelvan a producirse.
Gestión de la cobertura de pruebas:
Revisar de forma proactiva la cobertura de pruebas manuales y automatizadas, identificando y cubriendo cualquier vacío existente.
Estrategia y responsabilidad sobre la automatización:
Definir las estrategias, frameworks y herramientas de automatización para maximizar la cobertura y la eficiencia de las pruebas automatizadas. Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener scripts de automatización robustos, escalables y reutilizables para pruebas de API, UI e integración.
Mejora proactiva de procesos:
Analizar y mejorar los procesos de QA, identificando carencias y proponiendo mejoras antes de que afecten a la calidad del producto, fomentando una cultura de calidad desde las primeras fases del desarrollo.
Colaboración y comunicación transversal:
Participar activamente con product managers, desarrolladores, DevOps y otros stakeholders para asegurar que la calidad esté presente en todas las fases del desarrollo.
CI/CD y fiabilidad de las pruebas:
Configurar y optimizar pipelines de ejecución automatizada de pruebas dentro de entornos CI/CD, garantizando un feedback rápido y resultados fiables y consistentes.

Principales aptitudes y habilidades:

Mentalidad proactiva: con iniciativa y capacidad para anticiparse a los desafíos y actuar antes de que se conviertan en problemas.
Capacidad para liderar con el ejemplo y promover la mejora continua de la calidad.
Capacidad para equilibrar la velocidad de entrega con el nivel de testing adecuado en función del riesgo.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para liderar conversaciones entre equipos y cuestionar decisiones o planteamientos cuando sea necesario.
Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente manteniendo informados y alineados a los miembros del equipo y a los stakeholders sobre los riesgos y bloqueos relevantes.
Mentalidad analítica y gran atención al detalle.
Disposición para aprender nuevas técnicas y tecnologías.
Nivel de inglés conversacional.

Imprescindibles

Sólidos conocimientos de QA: capacidad para evaluar los riesgos del producto, definir estrategias de testing adecuadas, diseñar casos de prueba efectivos, identificar carencias en la cobertura de pruebas y aplicar enfoques de testing exploratorio y basado en riesgos.
Sólida experiencia en análisis y resolución de defectos: capacidad para reproducir problemas, analizar fallos, analizar la causa y comunicar los defectos de forma clara
Más de 3 años de experiencia en QA/testing, con experiencia práctica en automatización de pruebas.
Sólidos conocimientos de programación/scripting en al menos un lenguaje (Java, Kotlin, TypeScript/JavaScript, etc.).
Experiencia práctica en testing de aplicaciones en Android e iOS, utilizando tanto dispositivos físicos como emuladores/simuladores, incluyendo pruebas de permisos, comportamiento de la aplicación en diferentes condiciones de conectividad y escenarios específicos de cada plataforma.
Experiencia práctica en automatización de pruebas web y/o móviles utilizando herramientas como Playwright, Selenium, Appium o equivalentes
Buen conocimiento del testing de APIs, bases de datos y CI/CD, incluyendo validación de APIs, SQL básico e integración de pruebas automatizadas en pipelines CI/CD.
Buen manejo de Git y de los flujos de trabajo habituales de desarrollo

Se valorará

Experiencia en testing de extensiones de navegador, permisos, compatibilidad entre navegadores y procesos de instalación/actualización.
Experiencia con JIRA, Confluence y Testmo.
Familiaridad con Docker y plataformas cloud como AWS.
Experiencia en pruebas de rendimiento/carga, BDD/Cucumber, accesibilidad, seguridad o pruebas visuales.

¿Qué te ofrecemos en Netquest?

Seguro médico privado de cuadro médico o reembolso (cobertura del 50% a cargo de la empresa).
Plan de retribución flexible: cheques o tarjeta restaurante, transporte y guardería.
Horario laboral flexible: entrada entre las 8:00 y las 10:00, y salida entre las 17:00 y las 19:00. Jornada intensiva los viernes, con salida adelantada entre las 14:00 y las 15:00.
Modelo híbrido de trabajo: 2 días en la oficina y el resto desde casa (teletrabajo).
Fruta fresca y café de calidad siempre disponibles en la oficina.
Entorno colaborativo e enfocado en la innovación. Cultura de aprendizaje continuo y de compartir conocimiento.
Oportunidades para influir en la estrategia y arquitectura de datos a nivel de toda la compañía.

About the Client

Our client is a global technology and communications organisation providing mission-critical digital infrastructure and services to the aviation industry. Its technology supports airlines, airports and other aviation stakeholders across a highly distributed international environment, where reliability, scalability and operational resilience are essential.
As part of a major technology modernisation initiative, the business is evolving its platforms for monitoring, observability, provisioning and configuration management. This role will contribute to that transformation, working with engineering teams across Europe and North America.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Senior System Engineer to contribute to the modernisation of next-generation Datalink observability, monitoring, provisioning and configuration management platforms.
Based in Barcelona and working collaboratively with an international engineering team, you will contribute specialist technical expertise to the definition, architecture, design and implementation of complex software and platform capabilities.
The role requires someone who can operate autonomously, bring proven industry experience to complex technical challenges, and contribute across the full engineering lifecycle from concept and system definition through to production implementation.

Key Responsibilities:

System Engineering
Platform Modernisation
Technical Collaboration
Strategic Outcomes

Contractor Working Arrangement

The engagement is structured around the delivery of defined technical services and project outcomes.
Due to the collaborative and operational nature of the project, the services are expected to include approximately three days per week working from the project site in Barcelona, with the remaining services capable of being delivered remotely where appropriate. The on-site requirement reflects the operational and collaborative needs of the project, including access to relevant teams, technical environments and project activities.
The contractor will retain professional autonomy over the manner in which the services are delivered, subject to agreed project requirements, deliverables, security, confidentiality and site-access arrangements. The engagement is for the provision of specialist technical services and is not intended to create an employment relationship between the contractor and the client.

Required Experience

• 10+ years' experience as a Senior System Engineer, Senior Software Engineer or equivalent technical role within complex software, platform or technology environments.
• Strong experience with observability and monitoring ecosystems, including Grafana Labs technologies such as Alloy, Loki, Mimir or Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP).

• Experience within aviation, telecommunications, networking or other mission-critical technology environments.

• Familiarity with technologies and standards such as ServiceNow.

is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries.

DT-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team.

Job Description

The Project: Internal Support Tools Evolution

You are joining an initiative focused on the evolution, modernization of the Internal Application Landscape. This project involves the strategic transition of well-known cloud services and legacy .NET architectures into a next-generation, AI-augmented, and cloud-native software landscape.

Our goal is not simply to "maintain" the existing system, but to proactively transform it—ensuring sovereignty, high-performance scalability, and seamless handover readiness through disciplined engineering.

Our Engineering Philosophy

We operate at the intersection of Legacy Stability and Modern Innovation. Our approach is defined by:

AI-Augmented Engineering: We utilize advanced AI development environments (such as Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Code) and cutting-edge model families to accelerate code comprehension, refactoring, and documentation.
Disciplined SDLC Patterns: We move beyond traditional development by implementing repeatable, evidence-based SDLC patterns. Every change is backed by structured engineering evidence and rigorous automated testing.
The "Strangler Fig" Modernization: We prioritize risk-mitigated evolution, using sophisticated patterns to wrap, refactor, and eventually replace legacy components.
High-Seniority Autonomy: We operate as a lean, highly autonomous unit. We value "technical detectives" who can navigate ambiguity and perform deep reverse engineering.

Mission

To drive the technical execution of both high-impact feature development and the deep-dive modernization of our legacy .NET ecosystem. You will be a specialist who finds satisfaction in solving complex puzzles, utilizing AI-assisted tools to accelerate the modernization of our core systems.

Role Focus

This role focuses on high-complexity coding, deep reverse engineering, and AI-augmented productivity. You will work in the trenches of the legacy codebase, extracting logic and implementing modern, testable solutions using the latest AI-powered development environments.

Key Responsibilities

Complex Feature & Refactoring: Design and implement sophisticated new functionalities within the existing .NET ecosystem, ensuring seamless integration with legacy components.
Deep Reverse Engineering: Analyze and deconstruct complex, undocumented, or "spaghetti" legacy code to understand underlying business rules and technical flows.
AI-Augmented Coding: Proactively utilize AI coding assistants and advanced environments (e.g., Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, or VS Code extensions) to accelerate code comprehension, documentation, and refactoring.
Robust Testing & Stability: Write high-quality unit and integration tests to "wrap" legacy modules, providing a safety net for all refactoring efforts.
Technical Troubleshooting: Act as a high-level escalation point for complex bugs and performance bottlenecks within the legacy environment.
Internal Tooling: Utilize Microsoft PowerApps to build rapid, lightweight administrative or maintenance utilities to support the development and operations lifecycle.

Qualifications

Experience: 6+ years of professional software development experience, with deep expertise in the .NET/C# stack.
Legacy Navigation: Proven experience working with older .NET versions (e.g., .NET Framework) and managing the complexities of monolithic architectures.
AI Tooling Proficiency: Hands-on familiarity with AI coding assistants, prompt engineering, or local model experimentation.
Core Skills: Mastery of SOLID principles, design patterns, and advanced debugging/profiling techniques.
Testing Mindset: Strong commitment to TDD and automated testing (Unit/Integration) to protect the legacy core.

Additional Information

Please be informed that our remote working possibility is only available within Hungary due to European taxation regulation.

jobs.title: SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER (PUBLIC KEY INFRASTRUCTURE)
jobs.description:
Get to know the role

NETLOCK's certificate authority is the system behind every qualified certificate we issue - the platform that decides what a signature is actually worth. It has recently been modernised and now runs on Kubernetes. You'll own where it goes from here: the architecture, the reliability, and the cryptographic stack it's built on. This is a backend role, written in C, Go and Perl
. We don't expect all three on day one - we expect real strength in one and a genuine willingness to work across the rest. You'll develop the CA system and the independent services around it, work directly with hardware security modules and the interfaces connecting them to our services, and make architectural decisions in a system where correctness is the product. There is some web-related work, but it isn't the focus. You'll join a small, senior-leaning team that owns what it ships, from design through production. Cryptography and PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) experience is welcome, but it isn't a prerequisite: the domain is learnable, and we'll help you get there. What we can't teach is the appetite for taking long-term responsibility for a system rather than just delivering features into it.

What we offer?

You will be part of a young, supportive, and dynamic team where junior and more experienced colleagues collaborate closely, support each other, and openly share their knowledge and experience.
You will work in a modern technology environment where you can freely use the latest tools, technologies, and AI-driven solutions to support your work and drive innovation.
To make your workdays more enjoyable, we provide unlimited coffee so you can recharge during breaks and informal moments with your colleagues.
We offer a competitive and above-market salary that reflects your expertise, performance, and the energy you invest in your work.
In addition to competitive base benefits, after successfully completing your probation period you will also receive a high-value cafeteria benefits package that can be flexibly tailored to your personal needs and lifestyle.
The health and well-being of our employees is important to us, which is why after your probation period we provide a comprehensive private health insurance package, allowing you to focus on your work while feeling secure in your everyday life.
In this role, you can expect a high degree of autonomy, giving space for initiative and ownership, while also offering opportunities for rapid professional growth and continuous learning.

As a member of our team, you will be responsible for:

Own the PKI services end to end - architecture, development, maintenance, and how they behave in production.
Develop the certificate authority system and the independent services around it.
Keep the cryptographic stack current and lead upgrades to supported, long-term versions.
Work directly with hardware security modules and the interfaces connecting them to our services.
Make architectural decisions in a security-critical system and see them through to production.
Improve how we build, test, and ship - from local development to deployment.
Ship what you build and keep it healthy: observability, alerting, and a hand in on-call.

This opportunity is for you if you…

have senior-level software engineering experience, primarily in backend development, with a minimum of 3–5 years in production,
are strong in at least one of C, Go or Perl, and genuinely willing to learn and work in all three,
have experience with relational databases (we use MySQL),
have designed and operated systems made up of multiple independent services, and keep them correct across service boundaries,
take long-term responsibility for a system rather than just delivering features into it,
are fluent with AI-assisted coding workflows,
pick up new languages and unfamiliar domains quickly, and find hard problems satisfying rather than draining,
are a native Hungarian speaker (spoken and written) with professional English.

It’s a plus if you...

bring cryptography or PKI knowledge of any kind - it isn't a prerequisite, but we're glad to see it,
have worked with OpenSSL, hardware crypto devices, or PKCS#11,
are at home with Kubernetes and its surrounding tooling,
have built CI/CD pipelines end to end, from build to deployment across Dev, Staging and Prod,
have a background in a regulated, security-critical domain (e.g. eIDAS, trust services, finance),
are open to picking up new scripting languages.

What happens after you apply?

Once your application reaches us, our team carefully reviews it to see how well your experience and skills match the role.
If there’s a strong fit, we’ll invite you to a short introductory phone call to go through the key details and get to know each other.
As a next step, you’ll be invited to a personal interview with our HR team and the hiring manager. This is a great opportunity for you to learn more about the role, the team, and ask any questions about the day-to-day work.

Who we are?

We are a global trust-technology company with more than 25 years of experience in digital identity, advanced cryptography, and qualified trust services. Originating in Hungary and operating internationally with offices in Florida, US and Budapest, HU, we combine European regulatory strength with global reach.

Our team includes one of the region’s largest groups of PKI specialists, cryptographers, and security engineers, experts who have helped shaping the foundations of modern digital trust. As one of Europe’s earliest Qualified Trust Service Providers, we pioneered solutions in electronic signatures, identity verification, cryptographic infrastructure, and content authenticity.
Today, we enable organizations not only to verify identities and sign securely, but to trust their digital world in a way that was never possible before. At the heart of this leap forward is our world-first twin-engine solution: the fusion of C2PA provenance and qualified electronic signatures. This breakthrough creates a verifiable chain of trust for any digital asset, from documents to images to complex media, redefining what authenticity means in the age of AI. It elevates our long-standing trust-service foundations into a new standard for digital truth.

As technology evolves, we are committed to integrating the latest breakthroughs in cryptography, provenance, and AI-driven verification, ensuring trust remains one step ahead of innovation. Our mission is simple: To restore trust in the digital world.

Manual & Exploratory Testing: Conduct thorough manual and exploratory testing to catch edge cases, usability flaws, and visual inconsistencies that automated scripts miss.
Product Polish Advocate: Serve as the ultimate filter for product quality, ensuring UI/UX flows are intuitive, seamless, and pixel-perfect prior to release.

Extensive experience working in Agile/Scrum methodologies with active participation in sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives.
An exceptional eye for detail with a relentless drive to ensure products look, feel, and function flawlessly.
Comfortable writing SQL queries for database verification, inspecting network calls, and analyzing system logs.
Confident and willing to engage directly with clients and stakeholders as needed.

Experience presenting technical demos or managing UAT sessions with client stakeholders.
Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
Familiarity with security testing practices and OWASP principles.
ISTQB certification or equivalent software testing credential.

Wellbeing-focused initiatives and resources, designed to enhance your personal and professional life.

new_jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer
new_jobs.description:
Functieomschrijving

Bouw mee aan de toekomst van kassasoftware

Retail staat nooit stil. Ook onze kassasoftware moet betrouwbaar, gebruiksvriendelijk en toekomstbestendig blijven — op de winkelvloer, op drukke momenten en voor de retailers die erop vertrouwen.

Voor ons Customer Experience team zoeken we een senior .NET developer die niet alleen sterke software bouwt, maar ook helpt onze bestaande codebase fundamenteel verder te brengen. Een belangrijk deel van je werk is een gerichte refactoring: naar een architectuur die beter onderhoudbaar en testbaar is, waarin testautomatisering vanzelfsprekender wordt en waarin teams effectief en verantwoord met AI kunnen ontwikkelen.

Je komt terecht in een rol met inhoudelijke diepgang én zichtbare impact op een product dat dagelijks door retailers wordt gebruikt.

Hoe ziet jouw dag er precies uit?

Je werkt in het Customer Experience team aan onze Windows-kassaclient en aan de technische basis daaromheen. Samen met collega’s uit development en product vertaal je klant- en gebruikersbehoeften naar robuuste software.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

Het ontwerpen en realiseren van nieuwe functionaliteit voor onze kassasoftware.
Het stapsgewijs refactoren en moderniseren van bestaande .NET-code, zonder de continuïteit voor onze klanten uit het oog te verliezen.
Het verbeteren van architectuur, modulariteit, afhankelijkheden en codekwaliteit.
Het creëren van een codebase die beter testbaar is en waarin geautomatiseerde tests eenvoudiger en betrouwbaarder kunnen worden toegevoegd en onderhouden.
Het opzetten en verbeteren van unit-, integratie- en waar relevant end-to-end testautomatisering.
Het toepassen en verder ontwikkelen van een AI-native SDLC: van analyse en ontwerp tot implementatie, testen, code review en documentatie.
Het kritisch beoordelen, testen en verbeteren van door AI gegenereerde voorstellen en code.
Het delen van kennis en het helpen van collega’s om AI-first development effectief, veilig en met behoud van vakmanschap toe te passen.
Het samenwerken met product, UX en andere developmentteams om technische keuzes te verbinden met klantwaarde.

Wat bieden we jou?

Een inhoudelijk uitdagende seniorrol met directe invloed op de toekomst van onze kassasoftware.
De ruimte om een belangrijke refactoring en moderniseringsslag daadwerkelijk vorm te geven
Een omgeving waarin AI-first development serieus wordt genomen en waarin je actief kunt bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering daarvan.
Samenwerking met betrokken collega’s in een informele organisatie met korte lijnen.
Veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.
Hybride werken, met Breda als kantoorlocatie.
Marktconform salaris en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Ruimte voor persoonlijke en technische ontwikkeling.

Vereisten

Wat zoeken wij?
Je technische skills

Je bent een ervaren software engineer die eigenaarschap neemt en technische vraagstukken graag tot de kern doorgrondt. Je combineert pragmatisme met hoge kwaliteitsstandaarden: je weet wanneer een snelle verbetering passend is, maar ook wanneer een structurele oplossing nodig is.
Zeer ruime, aantoonbare ervaring met C# en het .NET-ecosysteem.
Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van bedrijfskritische applicaties met een langere technische historie.
Goede kennis van objectgericht ontwerp, SOLID-principes, dependency injection, async/await en gangbare design patterns
Ervaring met refactoring van complexe codebases en het stapsgewijs verbeteren van architectuur en maintainability.
Sterke ervaring met geautomatiseerd testen, bijvoorbeeld met unit tests, integratietests, mocking en testbare architectuur.
Ervaring met WPF en .NET Framework; ervaring met .NET MAUI is een plus.
Ervaring met bijvoorbeeld Entity Framework, NuGet, CI/CD en Git-gebaseerde ontwikkelprocessen.
Een kritische blik op requirements, technische keuzes en kwaliteit.
Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels.

AI-first development is voor jou de standaard

Voor deze rol zoeken we nadrukkelijk geen kandidaat die AI slechts af en toe als hulpmiddel inzet. Jij hebt AI-first development volledig omarmd en weet hoe je dit vertaalt naar een professionele softwareontwikkelpraktijk.

Dat betekent dat je ervaring hebt met het inzetten van AI in meerdere fasen van de SDLC, bijvoorbeeld voor analyse, ontwerp, implementatie, testautomatisering, refactoring, documentatie en code review. Je begrijpt tegelijk dat AI geen vervanging is voor engineering judgement: je kunt output valideren, risico’s herkennen, kwaliteit bewaken en de juiste technische beslissingen blijven nemen.

Je hebt een duidelijke visie op hoe AI helpt om sneller en beter te leveren, zonder concessies te doen aan betrouwbaarheid, security, testbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid. Je soft skills

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je bouwt én voor de kwaliteit van de technische omgeving waarin je werkt.
Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt complexe legacy- of architectuurvraagstukken overzichtelijk maken
Je bent nieuwsgierig, blijft jezelf ontwikkelen en deelt graag kennis met anderen
Je werkt graag samen, maar kunt ook zelfstandig richting geven aan technische verbeteringen.
Je durft bestaande aannames en oplossingen ter discussie te stellen als dat leidt tot een beter resultaat.
Je hebt oog voor de gebruiker én voor de lange termijn van het product.

new_jobs.title: Back-end C# / .NET Developer
new_jobs.description:
Jij bouwt aan het technische hart van onze e-commerce operatie: een event-driven landschap in AWS dat dagelijks 1.200 orders door meer dan 20 verkoopkanalen en 30+ landen loodst.
En je verkent met ons spec-driven development met AI-agents, waarbij het zwaartepunt van je werk verschuift naar intentie, architectuur en review.

De uitdaging

Ons e-commerceplatform wordt extern ontwikkeld, maar alle integraties tussen systemen en diverse eigen tools bouwen en beheren we zelf. Daarmee houden we de regie over performance, betrouwbaarheid en innovatie. Je krijgt een centrale rol in dat landschap: jij zorgt dat de keten blijft draaien en toekomstbestendig is, en je beslist mee over architectuur en technische keuzes.

Daarnaast werk je spec-first met AI-agents: je werkt uit wat een verandering moet doen, de agent bouwt, en jij verifieert build, tests en diff voordat er iets naar review gaat. Niets wordt ongelezen of onbegrepen gemerged. Deze aanpak is volop in ontwikkeling, en jouw ervaring en inzicht bepalen mede waar hij heen gaat. We zetten AI in als sparringspartner op complexe onderwerpen en versneller op duidelijke repitieve taken.

Wat ga je doen?

Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt back-end microservices in C# .NET (8.0), in leesbare en testbare code
Je bouwt en beheert event-driven integraties in AWS tussen ons e-commerceplatform, ERP (NetSuite), WMS en onze eigen tools
Je automatiseert binnen NetSuite in JavaScript/SuiteScript
Je zet AI in waar het jou versnelt, jij staat voor de kwaliteit, maar delegeert taken aan een agent waar dat voor jou werkt.
Je schrijft de spec, verifieert build, tests en diff van wat de AI-agent bouwt, en staat in voor wat er in de pull request komt
Je reviewt pull requests van collega’s en agents tegen de spec en onze standaarden
Je bewaakt performance, stabiliteit en security van koppelingen die wekelijks miljoenen berichten verwerken
Je vertaalt wensen van key-users en business owners naar een technisch plan dat je zelf implementeert

Wat werken bij KATO Group bijzonder maakt

KATO Group is onze bedrijfsnaam (Knives And Tools Online), Knivesandtools hoe consumenten in heel Europa ons kennen. Sinds 1999 is Knivesandtools dé snoepwinkel voor iedereen die houdt van hoogwaardige gear. Messen, keukengerei, bijlen, zaklampen, multitools, slijpsystemen, houtsnijsets… als het goed gemaakt is en leuk om te gebruiken, hebben we het waarschijnlijk op voorraad..

Achter die winkel zit een complex landschap van best-of-breed SaaS, eigen software en veel data. Je werkt in een klein IT-team en schakelt direct met Business Development, Finance en key-users uit de operatie. Weinig managementlagen, korte lijnen, en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief: je overlegt met de mensen die de beslissing nemen en met jouw oplossingen werken.

Wat wij bieden:

Een salaris tussen € 4.200 en € 4.800 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur
32 tot 40 uur per week, met ruimte voor ontwikkeling en een gezonde werk-privébalans
Toegang tot frontier modellen en coding frameworks voor agentic development
25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld
Reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling
20% personeelskorting op ons hele assortiment aan Next Level Gear
Een platte, informele organisatie met korte lijnen en veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid
En ja: de beste koffie van Apeldoorn, verse lunches van onze chef Jesse, en een pingpongtafel voor de broodnodige pauze

Wat je meebrengt:

Ten minste 3 jaar ervaring als back-end developer
Sterke kennis van C#, .NET (8.0) en relationele databases
Ervaring met cloud omgevingen (AWS en/of Azure)
Ervaring met het reviewen van code van anderen
Uitstekend Nederlands en Engels in woord en geschrift

Fijn als je dit ook hebt

Ervaring met AWS Lambda, SQS, Terraform of andere IaC-tools
Ervaring met agentic of spec-driven development
Ervaring met JavaScript en/of SuiteScript (NetSuite)

Solliciteren

Stuur je cv met een korte motivatie: van jezelf, niet van AI. Geen lang verhaal nodig: we maken liever kennis in een gesprek op kantoor in Apeldoorn, gevolgd door een vervolggesprek met het team en soms een proefopdracht of meeloopdag. Daarna stemmen we de voorwaarden af en plannen we je onboarding met directie en teams.

Heb je vragen over de rol of het proces, of heb je iets nodig om goed te kunnen solliciteren? Laat het ons weten, dan denken we mee.

new_jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer(EN)
new_jobs.description:
Create your own future

As a Senior .NET Developer in the Nexus Team, you will help build the foundation for future digital solutions within our Private Clients business.

The Nexus Team is responsible for developing an Operational Data Store (ODS): a central data platform that brings together information from multiple source systems, standardises it, and makes it available for applications across the organisation. By creating a consistent and reliable data layer, we enable development teams to make better use of data. While this is a Senior .NET Developer role, the focus is primarily on backend development.

This is a highly autonomous role in a lean team. You will not only build solutions, but also help shape the future of the platform. You will work in a complex environment where business processes, applications and data models come together.

We believe that the best solutions come from truly understanding the problem first. That's why we're looking for someone who is curious and enjoys investigating how things work, actively engages with stakeholders, challenges assumptions, and translates complex questions into scalable technical solutions.

Your responsibilities

Design, build and maintain services and applications on top of the Operational Data Store
Develop backend functionality and integrations using C# .NET and Azure SQL
Help migrate functionality from existing APIs to the new data layer where appropriate
Integrate and standardise data from multiple source systems
Contribute to the evolution of the data model and platform architecture
Work closely with business stakeholders, architects and development teams to understand requirements and identify opportunities for improvement
Investigate complex data and application landscapes and propose solutions that balance business and technical needs
Take ownership from analysis through implementation

Your talents

As a Senior .NET Developer, you are independent, analytical and proactive. You enjoy working in an environment where not everything is defined upfront and where discovering the right solution is part of the job.

You are someone who wants to understand how things really work. You ask questions, challenge assumptions and are comfortable forming and defending your own view on technical and functional decisions.

In addition, you have:

At least 5 years of experience with C# .NET development
Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases
Experience building integrations between systems and applications
Experience working with Azure-based solutions
An affinity for data modelling and complex data structures
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience working in Agile teams

Move ahead at Van Lanschot Kempen

Investing in a more future-oriented, sustainable, and data-driven way with various clients. Both nationally and internationally. With nearly 300 years of experience, we make this ambition a reality at Van Lanschot Kempen. We do this with more than 2,100 colleagues in various fields of expertise.

Within the Nexus Team you will join a group of senior professionals in a Scrum team with a clear mission: creating a reliable and future-proof data foundation for applications within the Private Clients domain. Because the team is lean, your contribution has a direct impact on the direction of the platform. You will have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, shape solutions, and work on challenges that combine software engineering, architecture, and data. We offer an environment where ownership, curiosity and initiative are valued. Technical expertise matters, but your ability to navigate complexity is what will make the difference.

An organisation's degree of innovation and agility also depends on the diversity of its workforce. Our differences make us stronger together. We promote an inclusive work environment where all colleagues feel at home. With us, you can be yourself. And we are proud of that.

Curious about the stories of colleagues and how they experience working at Van Lanschot Kempen? Go to Podcasts and find out more

That's what we do. The fact is, if you add value, you can expect the same from us in return. A good work-life balance with our 'hybrid way of working' is a good example of this. As Senior .NET Developer, you will also be given:

a gross monthly salary between €5.500 and 7000 commensurate with your knowledge and experience.
additional flexible budget of 19.47% of your gross salary (containing a 13th month, 8% holiday allowance & 7 extra legal leave days) You can utilize this by buying a bike, monthly gym membership, but also to save up for a sabbatical! It’s also possible to get the full budget paid out at any moment in the year.
an employee share plan, where Van Lanschot Kempen doubles your investment (of max. €3.500 a year) in Van Lanschot Kempen shares.
27 leave days of which 7 are part of the flexible budget.
working from home equipment such as electric standing desk, chair, a number of screens of your choice can be ordered and sent to your home.
your commute to work is compensated, including green options of walking and biking to work!
working from home allowance.
the option of exchanging national public holidays for religious holidays.
a free Van Lanschot Kempen bank account and other employee conditions, such as a discount on an Evi (investment) account.
a market competitive pension scheme. The exact contribution is based on your salary and age, generally, most people can expect around 20% contribution, which 4% is employee contribution.
a number of communities and events throughout the year, communities such as Young Professionals, Women, International, Pride, Sustainability, Sports clubs etc.
weekly drinks at our bar in the office.
Dutch and English language courses.
Hybrid working with flexibility, with the team typically in the Amsterdam office two days a week, Monday and Friday

And we have many other employment benefits ready for you. Discover all the benefits of working at Van Lanschot Kempen.

Excited about this opportunity? Apply through our website.

Bij Netcompany staat jouw persoonlijke en professionele groei centraal. Bij ons word je gekoppeld aan een mentor
die jou begeleidt, je helpt om jouw doelen te verwezenlijken en je waardevolle inzichten biedt in de diverse carrièremogelijkheden bij Netcompany. Daarnaast kun je deelnemen aan diverse cursussen en seminars via onze Netcompany Academy, die zich richten op technologie, management en communicatie. Alle sessies worden geleid door ervaren Netcompany collega’s, waardoor de inhoud altijd relevant is en aansluit op jouw huidige expertise.

Wil jij technisch eindverantwoordelijk zijn voor complexe softwareoplossingen én direct met klanten aan tafel zitten?
Als Medior Software Engineer / Consultant bij Netcompany combineer je je technische expertise met klantcontact. Je blijft zelf technisch actief, maar neemt daarnaast ownership over de kwaliteit en delivery van jouw deel van het project.

Je werkt aan digitale oplossingen voor grote organisaties en helpt klanten om complexe businessvraagstukken te vertalen naar schaalbare, toekomstbestendige software. Samen met developers, architecten, projectmanagers en de klant maak je technische keuzes die impact hebben.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Medior Software Engineer / Consultant Heb Je Een Belangrijke Rol In Het Succesvol Realiseren Van Onze Projecten. Je Werkzaamheden Bestaan Onder Andere Uit

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de technische kwaliteit en succesvolle delivery van een (sub)project, in samenwerking met de projectmanager.
Je adviseert klanten over technische oplossingen en vertaalt hun businessbehoeften naar schaalbare en onderhoudbare software.
Je werkt mee aan de technische oplossing en blijft waar nodig zelf hands-on betrokken bij development.
Je coacht en begeleidt junior developers en helpt hen groeien in hun technische en professionele ontwikkeling.
Je verdeelt werkzaamheden binnen het ontwikkelteam en zorgt voor een effectieve samenwerking.
Je werkt nauw samen met projectmanagers, architecten en andere stakeholders.

Wat breng jij mee?

(HBO) bachelor- of masterdiploma in een IT-gerelateerd vakgebied, bijvoorbeeld Computerwetenschappen, Informatica, Toegepaste Wiskunde, Elektrotechniek of Natuurkunde.
Je hebt 3+ jaar ervaring in softwareontwikkeling binnen complexe IT-projecten.
Ruime ervaring met Java óf .NET/C#. Je hoeft niet beide ecosystemen te beheersen.
Je bent gewend om technische verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en zelfstandig beslissingen te maken.
Je kunt technische vraagstukken vertalen naar oplossingen die aansluiten op de businessdoelstellingen van de klant.

Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief samen te werken met klanten, stakeholders en collega's.
Ervaring met Agile/Scrum.
Je beheerst zowel het Nederlands als het Engels uitstekend, in woord en geschrift.

NET
C#
Java
Angular
React
Azure Cloud

, combineren we configureerbare standaardsystemen met maatwerk waar dat nodig is. Hierdoor kunnen we sneller oplossingen realiseren, herbruikbare componenten inzetten en complexe businessvraagstukken met minder risico aanpakken.

Wat bieden wij?

Een bruto maandsalaris van €4.375 tot €5.200, afhankelijk van je ervaring, op basis van een fulltime dienstverband.
26 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld.
Een pensioenregeling waarbij Netcompany twee derde van de premie voor haar rekening neemt.
Volledige vergoeding van reiskosten met het openbaar vervoer of €0,25 per kilometer bij reizen met de auto.
Een thuiswerkvergoeding van €2,45 netto per dag.
De mogelijkheid om tot vijf vakantiedagen te kopen of te verkopen.
Een flexibele feestdagenregeling die rekening houdt met culturele en religieuze diversiteit.

Een kantoor met dagelijks premium snacks, koffie, thee en vers fruit.
Diverse sociale activiteiten, waaronder evenementen georganiseerd door AfterDark en jaarlijkse zomer- en winterfeesten.

Meer over benefits

What's in it for you?

Je deelt bij ons mee in de winst, boven op een vast salaris.
Altijd blijven groeien met ons development program.
Flexibele werktijden en hybride werken, afgestemd op je team en je klantverplichtingen.

Parttime (32 uur) of fulltime (40 uur) werken.
Ruil 3 nationale feestdagen voor 3 niet-nationale feestdagen, als je wilt.
